plugins.description: dsh-tool-tsfork — part of the hy-sde/dsh-plugins monorepo (DeepSeek Harness plugin).
plugins.readme_text:
<!-- MIRROR-NOTE:START -->
> [!NOTE]
> 📦 This plugin lives in the [**dsh-plugins**](https://github.com/hy-sde/dsh-plugins) monorepo — file issues & pull requests there.
> npm: [`@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork)
<!-- MIRROR-NOTE:END -->

# dsh-tool-tsfork — Go-native TypeScript compiler devices for DeepSeek Harness

A standalone package, installable as **one plugin** (two device tools) for the
DeepSeek Harness: model-facing devices over a **parked Go-native TypeScript
compiler** — the [can1357/TypeScript](https://github.com/can1357/TypeScript)
perf fork (`perf/checker-speedups-v3`, TS `7.1.0-dev`). `tsfork_status`
reports the binary, version banner and build stamp; `tsfork_check` runs
one-shot `-b` project-graph checks with parsed diagnostics, wall time, and a
GOMAXPROCS cap. The compiler binary is built once and parked on the host; the
plugin only speaks the harness device seam — zero upstream harness changes.

| Identity | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package | `@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork` |
| Plugin id | `hy-sde-tsfork` |
| Devices | `tsfork_status` · `tsfork_check` (device-catalog tools via `dyn`) |

> **Based on [can1357/TypeScript](https://github.com/can1357/TypeScript)**
> (`perf/checker-speedups-v3`, a Go rewrite of
> [microsoft/TypeScript](https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript), Apache-2.0
> lineage): no compiler code is ported or modified — this package is original
> plugin code that spawns the binary once per call over a stable CLI contract
> (`tsc -b`, JSON-free default output). Adapted, not ported: the harness
> device seam (`device: true` tools via `ctx.tools` + `ctx.systemPrompt`)
> exists so a deployment can expose a fast compiler without touching the
> repo's pinned toolchain. See
> [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).

## Why

The type gate on a large workspace is the stock `tsc -b` over the whole
solution graph — on the fork harness's 337-project host graph that was
**54.25s cold** (91.6s CPU, 4.6GB peak), and every agent that wants a
typecheck pays it serially. The Go compiler checks the same graph
byte-identically (project listings, 14/14 planted errors, deterministic
output) in **7.05s cold / ~0.6s warm** — 7.7× less wall time, 3.4× less CPU.
But nothing in a harness exposes it: gates run through `pnpm` scripts pinned
to `typescript@6.0.3`, and a plugin cannot replace a repo's own toolchain —
nor should it, because oxlint `typeAware` and the typert generator need the
JS API that TS 7 (a Go binary) does not ship. What agents need is a *device*
pointing at a parked binary: loadable per deployment, unloadable by toggling
one row, structured output, no PATH tricks, no upstream changes — while the
pinned toolchain stays exactly as pinned.

## Prerequisites

- Node.js **22.19 or newer** (the package's `engines` floor) with pnpm on `PATH`;
- a DeepSeek Harness installation with the device catalog (the package's peer
  baseline is `@deepseek-ai/cordis ~4.0.5-alpha.1`,
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt`
  `^0.2.1-alpha.2`; registries without the device concept simply present the
  tools eagerly);
- a tsfork compiler binary parked on the host (default `~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc`)
  with a `VERSION` stamp beside it — build it once from a checkout of the
  fork:

  ```bash
  git clone https://github.com/can1357/TypeScript.ts.git typescript.ts   # or your fork
  cd typescript.ts && git checkout perf/checker-speedups-v3
  go build -o ~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc ./cmd/tsc        # inside the tsc/ dir of the checkout
  printf 'source: can1357/TypeScript perf/checker-speedups-v3 @ <commit>\n' > ~/.dsh/tsfork/VERSION
  ```

  (the Go tree ships its generated files — no generate step; Go 1.27+)

## Quick start

### Route A — published npm package (recommended)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork
```

> Publishing after the Shape-A trial — until then use Route B.

### Route B — from source (validate this checkout or hack on the plugin)

```bash
git clone git@github.com:hy-sde/dsh-plugins.git
cd dsh-plugins/dsh-tool-tsfork/packages/tool-tsfork
pnpm install
PACKAGE_TARBALL="$(pnpm pack | tail -n 1)"
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/$PACKAGE_TARBALL"
cd ../../../..
```

Deployment variant used for the trial (no `dsh` CLI on PATH, hand-managed
profile): link the built package into the profile with an absolute `file:`
path — `pnpm add file:<abs-path-to-package>` in the profile dir, then add
`@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork` to `dsh.profile.bundles`. The package's own
`dsh.bundle.patch` mounts the `hy-sde-tsfork` row.

### Verify the composed configuration

```bash
dsh web --dump-config
```

### Run

Start the harness (`dsh web`) and ask the agent to check or probe a graph.
The model-facing calls (device catalog — `dyn search tsfork`):

- `tsfork_status` (no arguments) — resolved binary, `Version 7.1.0-dev`
  banner, build stamp from `<binaryDir>/VERSION`, 20s health probe.
- `tsfork_check` — `tsc -b <project>`; returns `exitCode`, `wallMs`,
  `errorCount`/`warningCount`, parsed `diagnostics` (`file:line:col TSxxxx`),
  an `outputTail`, and a reproducible `command`. `dry: true` prepends
  `--dry` (list the projects a build would run, without building). Pass
  `cwd` (and `project`) explicitly outside the deployment's default checkout.

### Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork
```

## What the bundle does

The plugin's `cordis.patch.yml` mounts **one plain agent-plane row**
(`hy-sde-tsfork`) that consumes the deployment's host services — `tools` and
`systemPrompt` (the stock agent bundle provides both). No service, realm, or
filesystem seam of its own: each call spawns the parked compiler once, so
concurrent agent lanes are isolated by construction and the only shared-box
knob is GOMAXPROCS. It also registers the `tsfork:tools` prompt section,
which documents the buildinfo gotcha and the adoption boundary to every
session that mounts the device.

## Engine behavior

- **One-shot spawn, stdin closed.** Every call is `spawn(binary, argv)` with
  `stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe']` — the compiler never reads stdin, and
  a held-open pipe is the classic CLI-wrapper hang.
- **Flag order.** The Go parser requires `-b`/`--build` to precede the
  project path; post-project flags (`--dry`, …) are accepted after it. A
  bare `tsc <tsconfig>` (no `-b`) fails with TS5112 — the plugin always
  sends `-b` first.
- **Timeout semantics.** SIGTERM at `timeoutMs`, SIGKILL 5s later — the
  escalation is scheduled *by* the timeout, never at spawn. A timed-out run
  resolves with `timedOut: true` and the partial output instead of rejecting.
- **Output caps.** stdout/stderr are captured up to `maxOutputBytes` per
  side (default 4 MiB, flagged `outputTruncated`); diagnostics are capped at
  500 with exact counts kept beyond the cap (`diagnosticsTruncated`).
- **`.tsbuildinfo` is compiler-version-tagged.** Alternating `tsfork_check`
  with the repo's stock `tsc -b` invalidates the other side's incremental
  caches — runs go cold. The prompt section warns agents; pick a primary
  and accept the other side paying one cold run.
- **Adoption boundary.** tsfork does not replace the pinned `typescript@6.0.3`
  toolchain: oxlint `typeAware` and typert need the JS API (TS 7's npm
  package is a launcher shim with no `lib/typescript.js`). Promotion, if the
  trial proves out, is a `pnpm` override of the gate binary — not this
  plugin.

## Configuration

| Option | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `binary` | `~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc` | Compiler binary (expandable `~`), must be executable |
| `defaultProject` | — | `-b` project used when a call omits `project` |
| `defaultCwd` | — | Working directory used when a call omits `cwd` |
| `timeoutMs` | `900000` | Per-call process timeout |
| `gomaxprocs` | — | `GOMAXPROCS` written to the child env (lane-friendly parallelism cap) |
| `maxOutputBytes` | `4000000` | Cap on captured stdout/stderr bytes per side |

```yaml
- id: hy-sde-tsfork
  config:
    binary: ~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc
    defaultProject: tsconfig.host.json
    defaultCwd: /path/to/your/checkout
    timeoutMs: 900000
    gomax

plugins.description: Use your Zed AI subscription (Pro / Student) from DeepSeek Harness: registers the zed-agent route with Claude + GPT models, an editable Models-page card and a model chooser.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zed-provider

Run your **Zed AI subscription** (Zed Pro / Student — the monthly prompt credits)
inside DeepSeek Harness. The bundle registers one LLM provider route,
`zed-agent`, whose turns are minted and streamed through Zed Cloud
(`https://cloud.zed.dev`) exactly as the Zed editor does it.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-zed-provider
```

## Link your Zed account

Type `/zed-login` in the Harness composer. The command opens Zed's native-app
sign-in page, waits for the loopback callback, and stores the resulting grant in
the Harness credential store (`llm-zed/zed-agent`). Later requests reuse it, and
the short-lived gateway token is minted automatically and refreshed on demand.

Credentials are resolved in this order, so any one of them is enough:

1. `config.credentials` — a literal `"<userId> <accessToken>"` (or JSON) value.
2. `config.apiKeyEnv` (default `ZED_CREDENTIALS`) — resolved through the
   credential seam. The Models settings page shows this as the Zed card's key
   field, so a credential pasted there works without `/zed-login`.
3. The `llm-zed/zed-agent` grant record written by `/zed-login`.
4. The Zed editor's own local keyring entry, on macOS (`zed.dev`) and Linux
   (`secret-tool`), imported once into the grant record — sign in inside Zed and
   this plugin picks it up by itself.

`apiKeyEnv` is spelled that way because the Models page reads exactly that field
name; its value is a credential *reference*, and what it holds is the
`"<userId> <accessToken>"` pair Zed issues.

## Settings UI

Settings → **Models** → the **Zed** card carries this bundle's own editor
(`lib/client.js`, a client-module half registered on the page's
`settings.models.provider-card` seat for the `llm-zed` namespace):

- credential status, from the card's credential join plus a live
  `credentials/describe`;
- a credential field that stores `"<userId> <accessToken>"` under the reference
  `apiKeyEnv` names (read live from the settings document, default
  `ZED_CREDENTIALS`), with **Remove** to unset it;
- a refusal instead of a silent no-op when that reference is supplied by a
  read-only source such as an environment variable.

It also carries the **model chooser**: the Host registers
`llm.registerModelDiscovery` for this namespace, the page reads it through
`llm/discoverModels`, and the tick boxes write `visibleModels` through
`settings/mutate`. That field is volatile, so a tick changes the picker on the
next catalog read without a reload; an empty or complete selection unsets it,
meaning "offer every model this plugin can run".

`baseUrl` stays a composition-only field in `cordis.patch.yml`.

The client fiber hard-injects only `slots`, `locale` and `remote`, and picks the
credential remote up through `ctx.inject(['remote.credentials'], …)`. That is
deliberate: the web boot asserts that every client entry activated, so a root
client plugin that waits on a service the settings UI keeps private (such as
`settingsScope`) takes the whole GUI boot down with
`<package>: pending (waiting for service: …)`.

## Models

`listModels` reads `GET /models` with your credential and advertises the models
Zed reports for the backends this plugin implements — **Claude** (Anthropic
Messages) and **GPT** (OpenAI Responses). Zed's Gemini and Grok entries are
filtered out rather than offered broken; selecting one anyway fails fast with
`UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`.

Each model carries Zed's own context window, output cap, and — when
`supports_thinking` — the effort levels `off` / `low` / `high` / `max`, mapped
onto Anthropic extended thinking budgets.

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKeyEnv` | `ZED_CREDENTIALS` | Credential reference holding `"<userId> <accessToken>"`. |
| `credentials` | absent | Literal credential value; highest priority, composition-time. |
| `baseUrl` | `https://cloud.zed.dev` | Zed Cloud endpoint. |
| `visibleModels` | all supported | Narrow the catalog to these model ids. |

## Quota

Zed owns the accounting: no plan or no credits left answers HTTP 402, which
surfaces as a `QUOTA` failure naming https://zed.dev/account. The plugin does
not invent percentages or limits.

## Development

`pnpm install` (which runs the `prepare` hook), then `pnpm check` —
typecheck, build, tests. Sources are TypeScript under `src/`; `lib/` is build
output and is git-ignored, because the `prepare`/`prepack` hooks rebuild it
wherever the package is consumed and the published tarball carries the built
copy through the `files` allowlist.

A profile can install this bundle as a `link:` to a working copy, in which case
that copy's `lib/` is what the Host imports: rebuild after changing `src/`, or
the Host keeps running the previous build.

`node --test test/*.test.mjs` covers the pieces that fail silently in
production: the NDJSON → `StreamChunk` translation for both backends
(`src/frames.ts` framing, `src/parse.ts` Anthropic events, `src/responses.ts`
Responses events), the RSA sign-in handshake (`src/signin.ts`), the request
projections (`src/anthropic.ts`, `src/responses.ts`), and the card's slot
registration, credential and model-selection wiring (`src/client.ts`, loaded
under a stubbed module loader in `test/client.test.mjs`). The tests import the
built `lib/`, because that is what the Harness actually runs. Only
`src/index.ts` touches the Harness runtime.

Two install-time facts worth knowing: the Host half is re-imported only by a
profile restart (ESM caches by URL), and the client half is composed from the
Loader's entries at Host boot, so adding or removing `exports["./client"]` takes
a restart too — after that it is served per request under a content hash, so
client-side edits reach the browser on the next load.

plugins.description: DSH 联网搜索的提供方优先级：Tavily 与 DeepSeek 原生搜索自由排序、失败自动回退，Tavily 侧多密钥轮换分摊每日额度
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-search-plus

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-web-search-plus)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-web-search-plus)
[![stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/polan-prologue/dsh-web-search-plus?style=flat)](https://github.com/polan-prologue/dsh-web-search-plus)

Provider **priority** for DeepSeek Harness web search: put Tavily and the native DeepSeek
provider in whatever order you want, fall through to the next one when the first fails, and
rotate several Tavily keys to spread the free daily quota.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-web-search-plus
```

Refresh the browser once, then open **Plugins → 网页搜索++** and press **Take over**.

Pinned tag instead of the npm release:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:polan-prologue/dsh-web-search-plus#v0.1.2
```

**Requires dsh 0.1.0 or newer.** The plugin talks to the `ctx.web` seam and the `webServer`
prefix routes; on an older host it registers nothing and says why in the log.

## Why this exists

The `ctx.web` seam selects **exactly one** provider by id:

| State | What the seam does |
|---|---|
| A provider id is configured | Uses only that one; failure is failure |
| No id, exactly one provider usable | Uses it |
| No id, several usable | Throws `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS` |

There is no priority chain and no fallback. This plugin registers **one** provider
(`web-search-plus`) and runs the chain inside it:

```
web_search tool
   └─ ctx.web (pinned to web-search-plus)
        ├─ 1. Tavily            → rotates across your key slots
        └─ 2. DeepSeek native   → reuses the official provider instance
```

The DeepSeek node calls the **official provider instance** rather than re-implementing it, so
its key, account token, endpoint and usage limits keep coming from **Settings → Web search** —
nothing drifts when upstream changes.

## What you get

- **Ordered fallback** — move the two providers up and down; the first one that answers wins, the next runs when the previous fails or (optionally) returns nothing
- **Multi-key rotation** — up to 20 Tavily key slots. A rate-limited (`429`) or quota-exhausted key cools down and the chain moves to the next one automatically; each slot shows its live state (`ready` / `invalid` / `cooling down`) and the one in use is marked
- **Per-key usage** — ask Tavily for each slot's current plan usage in one click, so you can see which key is nearly spent before a search fails
- **Hand back cleanly** — *Hand back to official search* writes `deepseek-official` back to the `web` row and the chain stops being consulted. The *Try one search* probe follows the same state, so it never claims the chain ran while the seam points somewhere else
- **Secrets stay in the credential domain** — keys are written through `ctx.credentials`, never to the settings file, never into a snapshot response, never into a log. Saved keys can be revealed on request with the eye button, which asks the host for exactly one slot over a loopback-only, no-store route
- **No surprises on the page** — an action locks only its own control group; the 1 s cooldown ticker does not repaint the cards; the note line keeps its height so cards do not shift when a message appears
- **Bilingual UI** — follows the interface language (`zh` / `en`)

## Manage it from the Plugins page

The settings card lives in **Plugins → 网页搜索++**, and falls back to the kernel
**Built-in plugins** page when the experience platform is absent. Four cards:

| Card | What it does |
|---|---|
| Priority | Reorder the chain; one switch decides whether the chain is consulted at all |
| Tavily keys | Key slots, per-slot state, reveal / save / clear / remove, add slot, reset cooldowns |
| Tavily options | Endpoint, search depth, result cap, timeout, rate-limit cooldown, answer summary |
| Status | Takeover state, chain availability, run one probe, fetch per-key usage |

## How the chain actually behaves

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| First node answers | Its result is returned; later nodes are not called |
| First node throws | Reason is recorded, next node runs |
| Node is not registered | Recorded as *not registered*, next node runs |
| Caller cancels | Propagates immediately — cancellation does **not** fall through |
| Every node fails | `WEB_SEARCH_CHAIN_EXHAUSTED`, one line per node with its reason |

With `fallbackOnEmpty` on, an **empty** result counts as a failure and the chain continues; off,
an empty result is a legitimate answer.

## Security

- Management routes accept **loopback only**, and additionally require a loopback `Host`, a same-origin `Origin` when present, a non-`cross-site` `Sec-Fetch-Site`, and `application/json` on writes — so a page in your browser cannot read your keys even though these routes sit outside the host's session auth
- Key values are write-only in every listing: `GET` never contains a secret
- The reveal route returns **one** slot per request, carries `no-store`, refuses refs that are not configured, and is never called automatically
- The publish step runs `tools/scan-sensitive.mjs`, which blocks API-key shapes, private keys, connection strings, personal paths and session ids

## Configuration

Every option lives in the plugin row of your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and is editable from
the page:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `priority` | `[tavily, deepseek-official]` | Chain order |
| `tavilyKeyRefs` | `[TAVILY_API_KEY]` | Credential refs, in rotation order |
| `tavilyBaseURL` | `https://api.tavily.com` | Endpoint (`/search` and `/usage` are appended) |
| `tavilyMaxResults` | `8` | Results per search (1–20) |
| `tavilySearchDepth` | `basic` | `basic` / `fast` / `ultra-fast` / `advanced` |
| `tavilyIncludeAnswer` | `true` | Ask Tavily for an LLM answer summary |
| `tavilyTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-request timeout |
| `tavilyRateLimitCooldownMs` | `60000` | Cooldown after a `429` |
| `fallbackOnEmpty` | `false` | Treat an empty result as a failure |

## Development

```sh
npm test          # 238 unit tests, no network, no keys
npm run test:live # real search against a real key
```

Layout: `lib/index.js` (host entry) · `lib/chain.js` (the chain) · `lib/tavily.js` (Tavily node
+ key ring) · `lib/routes.js` (management routes) · `lib/client.js` (browser half) ·
`lib/schema.js` (config) · `docs/开发踩坑记录.md` (pitfall log).

## Known limits

- Tavily's free tier is metered **per account**, so several keys only help when they come from different accounts
- `advanced` depth costs twice the credits
- The seam still selects one provider id; this plugin *is* that one provider — the ordering is its internal logic, not a seam feature
- Changing the `web` row's provider needs a host restart on some builds; the page says so instead of pretending

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DSH 审批弹窗 AI 注释器：模型请求权限外操作时，用模型自己的推理解释这次操作的意义与风险
plugins.readme_text: # DSH Approval Explainer English | [中文](README.zh.md) An AI annotator for the approval dialog in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`). When the model asks to run something outside your workspace, `dsh` shows an approval prompt. This plugin adds an explanation next to the command, generated from the model's own reasoning: what the code does, what the model is trying to achieve, how risky it is and why, and what each button actually means. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:ArisuYuuko/dsh-approval-explainer ``` `desktop` is the profile the desktop app boots. The first use of a profile initializes it. Then **fully quit and reopen DSH**. Reloading the page is not enough: the host half loads only at process start. Verify the layer was installed: ```sh dsh --profile desktop --dump-config ``` ```yaml # == dsh-approval-explainer - id: dsh-approval-explainer name: dsh-approval-explainer inject: - llm - approval ``` This plugin is plain JavaScript with no build step, so pnpm does not ask you to authorize `allowBuilds`. See [Install notes](#install-notes). To remove it, along with its configuration layer: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-approval-explainer ``` ## What it does Without the plugin an approval prompt shows only the command: ``` 即将执行 & '\diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl.ps1' -Path 'D:\some-project' -AllowRewrite ``` You have to work out what it does, what it touches, and what happens if you accept. If you cannot, you are choosing between trusting blindly and refusing blindly. The plugin adds this to the same prompt: ``` Risk = medium (confidence high) [What this code does] Writes ~300 words of acceptance notes to \note.txt outside the workspace, using danger-full-access (cwd is ). The text itself only describes a timeout fix and its measurements. [What the model is trying to achieve] You explicitly asked it to file an escalation request, so the model deliberately writes outside the workspace to trigger a real approval prompt and measure annotation latency. [Why this risk level] The content is harmless and this is not production, but it explicitly asks for danger-full-access and targets a path outside the workspace. That falls under permission and security controls, so the standard rating is medium. [Recommendation] Approve once: the content is harmless and matches your instruction, but let it through only this time rather than granting standing full-disk access. [What each option means] Approve once -> the text is really written to \note.txt and stays on disk until you delete it; other writes under the same grant are also allowed. Deny -> nothing is written and the latency check cannot complete; the model is told it was denied and may retry inside the workspace or stop and ask you. ``` Note the last block. It does not just say "the command will run" — it says the file will really be created, that it can be deleted, and that other writes are covered by the same grant. That is the information a decision needs. ### Design notes | | | |---|---| | **Only real approvals** | No annotations for routine tool calls. In one measurement `approval/request` fired 2 times while `tools/pre-execute` fired 259 — annotating everything is the same as annotating nothing | | **Never blocks approval** | Generation runs in the background; the prompt appears immediately. A failure or timeout cannot affect what you may approve | | **Failures are visible** | When generation fails the panel shows why instead of hanging silently | | **Arguments come from the session** | Tool arguments are looked up by `callId` in the session log, with three fallbacks. If they cannot be found the annotation says so instead of inventing them | | **Prompt-injection resistant** | The system prompt states that code, paths, and commands are data, not instructions | | **Does not change policy** | It observes the approval waterfall; it does not decide who may be authorized | ## How it works The plugin is a DSH **bundle**: an npm package carrying a `cordis.patch.yml` that contributes one configuration layer to a profile. ``` package.json declares dsh.bundle.patch, pointing at the layer file cordis.patch.yml the layer: one insert row referencing the package by name lib/index.js host half (Node) lib/client.js browser half (Web) ``` The whole install mechanism is five lines of YAML: ```yaml - insert: - id: dsh-approval-explainer name: dsh-approval-explainer # by package name, so Node resolution finds the installed code inject: - llm - approval ``` `dsh plugin add` installs the package into the profile and, because the package declares `dsh.bundle`, appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles`. The effective config gains one layer. ### The two halves ``` lib/index.js host half (Node) observes the approval/request waterfall, generates annotations in the background via the LLM, caches them, serves 8 HTTP routes lib/client.js browser half (Web) registers into the conversation.approval.detail slot and renders the command plus the annotation card ``` ### Key decisions **Only `approval/request` is hooked.** It is the only precise signal for "the user is being asked to decide something right now". An earlier version also hooked `tools/pre-execute` to pre-generate; the measured signal-to-noise was 259:2, where 259 routine operations drowned the 2 that mattered. **Approval is never blocked.** The listener starts background generation and immediately `return next()`, handing the decision back to the real policy listener. So a successful, failed, or timed-out generation cannot affect what you may approve. **Arguments are looked up in the session log.** The `approval/request` event carries **no tool arguments** (only `toolName`, `callId`, `reason`), so the plugin finds the `tool/call` event by `callId` with three fallbacks (`surface.nodes` → `snapshotEvents()` → `events`). When it cannot, the annotation says arguments are missing rather than inventing them. **Shadowing the official renderer requires an explicit priority.** `conversation.approval.detail` is a **single** slot, and the official `dsh-client-ui-chat` already occupies `priority: 0`. Two registrations at the same priority in one slot is an error, and `entriesOfSlot` takes the first entry in **ascending** priority order — so shadowing requires a **lower** number (`-1`). The cost is having to re-render the command line yourself. ### Two hard constraints **1. Never inject a client bundle yourself.** `dsh-client-modules` deduplicates by URL but rejects duplicate registrations by module id. If the host injects another `

plugins.description: The deterministic trust chain for DeepSeek Harness — nine plugins covering read/write/do/call/leave-behind/egress/told/running/remembered. Zero LLM in the trust path
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-trust-suite — the deterministic trust chain for DeepSeek Harness

> **If this helps you, please give it a star** — it helps others find it. Thanks!

One thesis, three plugins, zero LLM calls in the trust path:

> The dsh plugin ecosystem reviews agents with LLMs — answer reviewers,
> advisor loops, goal verifiers. Everything that *must not be an LLM* —
> the parts a probabilistic reviewer can be injected past — is what this
> family owns.

| Plugin | Guards | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [dsh-read-guard](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-read-guard) | what the agent **reads** | Prompt-injection interception in the `tools/post-execute` waterfall: file reads, repo searches, and web fetches are scanned before they enter model context — quarantined, blocked, or passed. Engine: [repo-inject-guard](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/repo-inject-guard) |
| [dsh-pr-gate](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-pr-gate) | what the agent **writes** | Deterministic write gate: scope policy denies out-of-scope writes before they touch the disk, residue rules scan the written text, a content-hashed JSONL ledger records every decision. The CI gate moved to the moment of the write. Engine: [agent-pr-gate](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-pr-gate) |
| [dsh-attest-chain](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-attest-chain) | what the agent **did** | Signed chain-of-custody: every watched tool result appends a hash-chained, ed25519-signed record. Tamper with a line, break the chain; delete the tail, break the published head. Engine: [agent-attest](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-attest) |
| [dsh-mcp-test](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-mcp-test) | what the agent **can call** | Tool-surface snapshot and drift gate: the full visible registry (first-party, plugin, MCP tools) is baselined and diffed — upgrades that silently change the model-visible surface fail loud. Methodology: [mcp-test](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/mcp-test) |
| [dsh-janitor](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-janitor) | what the agent **leaves behind** | Deterministic cleanup plans for session debris (plan docs, scratch scripts): scan → verdicts with evidence → review. The janitor is never an agent; v0.1 never deletes. Engine: [agent-janitor](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-janitor) |
| [dsh-egress-gate](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-egress-gate) | **where data may flow** | Destination allowlist for web fetches/searches, denied in `tools/pre-execute` before they run; shell fetch-verbs observed (enforcement opt-in). The other half of exfil defense: content scanning guards what enters, this guards where it leaves. |
| [dsh-prompt-drift](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-prompt-drift) | what the model is **told** | System-prompt surface drift gate: every section contributed by any plugin/preset is hashed and baselined; a silent rewrite of the prompt fails loud. |
| [dsh-freeze](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-freeze) | what exactly is **running** | Hermetic composition lock: the profile's dependencies, bundle order, lockfile hash, and patch layer are fingerprinted; booting a drifted composition warns — or fails under `strict` (the `--frozen` posture for CI). |

| [dsh-compaction-guard](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-compaction-guard) | what the agent **forgets** | Compaction integrity: directive lines from the compacted range are extracted and verified against the summary — verbatim or in substance; every constraint the agent silently forgot is reported and ledgered. |

Read + write + do + call + leave-behind + egress + told + running / remembered: the eight
channels through which an agent session can go wrong, each gated by a
deterministic rule engine with its own upstream test suite, Windows+Linux
CI, and an honest kill-criteria section.

| [dsh-trust-panel](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-trust-panel) | what the user **sees** | The plain-language dashboard for all nine channels: one status light, event cards a non-security user can act on, bilingual (zh/en). |

## Install the family

One command, from npm (v0.3.0+, the whole family in a single meta-bundle):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-trust-suite   # 9 guards + the trust-panel dashboard
```

Prefer git checkouts? One command per plugin, all prebuilt (no `allowBuilds`
step):

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-trust-suite/main/install.sh | bash -s -- web
# or explicitly:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-read-guard   # + pr-gate, attest-chain, mcp-test, janitor, egress-gate, prompt-drift, freeze
```

Each ships its own config in `cordis.patch.yml` and composes without
interference (different pipeline stages: read-guard observes results,
pr-gate gates writes, attest records everything, mcp-test watches the
registry, egress-gate checks destinations, prompt-drift watches the
assembled prompt, freeze pins the composition, janitor scans on demand).

## Why a family, and against whom

The dsh security lane (checked 2026-10-12) is a long tail without a winner:
~15 injection-defense plugins, none above 85★, the strongest being a
model-callable scanner (the model can decline to call it) and one
three-point interceptor with literal pattern lists. Nothing on the write
side, nothing on custody. The family's edge is not being first — it is that
every rule engine here is vendored from a battle-tested upstream repository
with its own CI, competitive analysis, and kill criteria, instead of being a
weekend pattern list. Few plugins, deep engines, upstream ownership — the
deliberate opposite of the 90-plugin land-grab strategy visible in the
ecosystem today.

## Roadmap (next in the family)

- **dsh-bench** has shipped as its own repo —
  [zhengqiuyang/dsh-bench](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-bench-local): bench
  your dsh configuration against your own tasks via `dsh headless`
  (live-verified). Its mining pillar (tasks from git history, graded by your
  own tests) ports agentbench-local next.
- **skills lockfile** — hermetic pinning for skills/plugins à la
  [vendor-skills](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/vendor-skills); today's
  supply-chain plugins all static-scan, none reproducibly pin.
- **mcp-test probe pillar** — behavioral + injection probes against running
  MCP servers (the headline feature of upstream mcp-test) on top of
  dsh-mcp-test's drift gate.

## Kill criteria

Per-plugin kill criteria live in each README. Family-level: if dsh ships a
first-party deterministic trust layer covering read/write/custody, the family
freezes and this README records the postmortem. The engines live on in their
upstream repositories regardless.

plugins.description: DSH Web plugin: replace the composer reasoning-effort picker with an inline slider card.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-reasoning-slider

把 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里的 **推理等级** 选择，从「点开二级菜单再点一行」改成一张 **卡片式滑块**。

| 浅色 | 深色 |
| --- | --- |
| ![浅色主题](docs/preview-light.png) | ![深色主题](docs/preview-dark.png) |

## 特性

- **滑块选档**：卡片底部一条轨道，蓝色填充 + 白色圆形滑块，未到达的档位用圆点标出。
- **三种操作方式**：拖拽滑块、点击轨道任意位置、键盘 `←` `→` `↑` `↓` / `Home` / `End`。
- **一键重置**：卡片右上角回到该模型的默认档；当前已是默认档时按钮置灰。
- **大字档位 + 说明**：卡片正中显示当前档位名称（`Off` / `Low` / `High` / `Max` …），下方是该档位的说明文字。
- **触发按钮上的刻度条**：不打开菜单也能一眼看出当前档位。
- **模型二级菜单保留**：分组、搜索、勾选、加载失败重试都在，只换成同一套卡片样式。
- **跟随明暗主题**：全部使用 DSH 设计令牌（`--dsw-alias-*`），浅色 / 深色自动适配；文案中英文自动切换。
- **不动官方插件**：官方 `ui-model-selection` 照常加载，它的 `modelDirectories` 服务和 `/model` 指令弹窗都能继续用。

![输入框里的触发按钮](docs/trigger.png)

## 安装

安装后 **刷新一次浏览器页面**（浏览器半边是在页面加载时注入的）。

### 方式一：插件页（推荐）

打开 DSH Web → **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，粘贴：

```
github:aci825223-ai/dsh-reasoning-slider
```

### 方式二：命令行

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile 名> add github:aci825223-ai/dsh-reasoning-slider
```

也接受完整地址：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/aci825223-ai/dsh-reasoning-slider`

装好后插件会出现在 **设置 → 插件 → 已安装** 列表里，开关默认打开。

### 方式三：预构建 tarball

不想让 pnpm 从源码取包的话，用 release 里附带的预构建包（地址固定，不带版本号，不会随发版失效）：

```
https://github.com/aci825223-ai/dsh-reasoning-slider/releases/latest/download/dsh-reasoning-slider.tgz
```

同样粘到 **添加插件** 里，或：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile 名> add https://github.com/aci825223-ai/dsh-reasoning-slider/releases/latest/download/dsh-reasoning-slider.tgz
```

### 方式四：本地源码（开发用）

把仓库克隆到任意位置，然后链接进 profile：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/aci825223-ai/dsh-reasoning-slider
New-Item -ItemType Junction `
  -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\node_modules\dsh-reasoning-slider" `
  -Target "<克隆下来的目录>"
```

再在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` 里把包加进依赖和 bundles 列表：

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-reasoning-slider": "link:<克隆下来的目录>" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "…", "dsh-reasoning-slider" ] } }
}
```

正在运行的 DSH 会监听 profile 组合并自动重载，浏览器刷新即可看到效果。

## 卸载

设置 → 插件 → 已安装 → 关掉 **dsh-reasoning-slider** 的开关（或删除它），刷新页面即回到官方样式。

手动安装的话，从 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉这一项，并删除
`node_modules\dsh-reasoning-slider` 链接。

## 工作原理

官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection` 用默认优先级 `0` 占用了单占位槽
`conversation.input.model`。`dsh-client-ui-slots` 对同名单槽的规则是
**「同优先级重复注册直接报错，换一个优先级即可遮蔽，优先级最低者渲染」**，
所以本插件用 `priority: -1` 注册自己的组件，渲染权落到本插件，而官方那份仍然被加载，
其服务与指令不受影响 —— 不需要 `disabled: true` 去覆盖官方设置页。

数据全部来自占位槽注入的 props（`available` / `directory` / `load` / `select`），与官方组件一致；
写回同样走 `select({ provider, model, reasoningEffort })`。

### 两个坑（写同类插件的人可以抄）

- **必须声明 `remote` + `remote.session`**：`directoryFor()` 内部会访问 `ctx.remote.session` /
  `ctx.sessions`，而 Cordis 是按 **调用方** 的 inject 声明做访问检查的。漏声明会在渲染时报
  `cannot get property "remote.session" without inject`，并让该槽位条目直接崩溃。
- **浏览器半边不需要构建**：手写 CJS 包体即可，只要 `factory` 返回 `module.exports`：

  ```js
  window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: '<包名>', factory: (require) => { /* … */ return module.exports; } });
  ```

  本插件只 `require` 平台基线模块（`react`、`react/jsx-runtime`、`react-dom`、
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`），因此 `dsh.client.external` 为空。

## 文件

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | 清单：`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client.platform: web` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 自挂载行（`id` 必须等于包名） |
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主半边（Web 端逻辑都在 client，这里只占位） |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半边：locale、样式、滑块、模型二级菜单、槽位注册 |

## 常见问题

**装完没变化？**
浏览器半边在页面加载时注入，刷新一次页面（`Ctrl+R`）即可。不用重启 DSH 服务。

**控制台报 `cannot get property "remote.session" without inject`？**
inject 里补上 `remote` 和 `remote.session`，见上文「两个坑」。

**和别的插件抢同一个槽位？**
单占位槽同优先级重复注册会直接抛错，换个优先级（例如 `-1`）就能并存并遮蔽。

**档位和模型的组合对不上？**
档位来自当前模型自身的 `reasoning` 声明：不同模型的档位数量、名称、默认档都可能不同，
卡片上的档位名与说明文字都取该模型自己的定义。

## 开发

没有构建步骤：直接改 `lib/client.js`，刷新页面即可。改完后插件宿主会自动重载并更新资源版本号。

```bash
node --check lib/client.js   # 语法检查
node --check lib/index.js
```

## 兼容性

在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`（profile 名 `tauri`，Web 端）上开发并验证。插件不声明 `peerDependencies`、
不声明 `dependencies`，因此不会与 profile 里已有的运行时冲突。

验证记录见 [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md)。

## English

`dsh-reasoning-slider` replaces the DeepSeek Harness composer's reasoning-effort picker with an
inline slider card: drag the thumb, click anywhere on the track, or use the arrow keys / `Home` /
`End`; the top-right button resets to the model's default effort. The model submenu (groups, search,
checkmarks) is kept in the same style. It shadows the shipped selector by registering into the
`conversation.input.model` single slot at `priority: -1`, so the official
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection` plugin keeps working untouched. Install with
`dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:aci825223-ai/dsh-reasoning-slider`, then refresh the page.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

# DSH 协作开发插件

[English](README.en.md) · [下载 v1.0.0](https://github.com/sxwer001/dsh-collab-dev/releases/tag/v1.0.0)

主智能体规划，子智能体并行开发，验证与独立审查通过后汇总交付。

## 安装

适用于 **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`**，需要已配置的模型和 Node.js ≥22.19.0。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/sxwer001/dsh-collab-dev/releases/download/v1.0.0/dsh-collab-dev-1.0.0.tgz
```

网页版将 `desktop` 换成 `web`，安装后按宿主提示重启。本包已内置团队组件，同一 profile 请勿重复启用独立 AgentTeams bundle。

## 使用

```text
/collab-dev 为现有应用增加订单 API 和订单查询页面
```

1. 主智能体检查项目，建立共享框架、接口和完整任务计划。
2. 在团队面板审阅计划，点击 **Approve & Run**。
3. 两个 worker 并行开发，verifier 验证，reviewer 独立审查，最后集成。
4. 输入 `/collab-status` 查看进度、验证结果和交付阻塞。

计划和架构保存在 `.collab-dev/`。无效依赖、缺失验收阶段及并行写入范围冲突会被拒绝；上传不完整的计划无法批准运行。调整草稿任务数量时，请丢弃草稿并重新保存、创建计划。

## 范围

v1.0.0 使用 DSH 原生子智能体与共享工作区，按任务范围协作；不提供文件系统隔离、独立 worktree 或 Codex／Claude Code 后端。目前已验证 Windows、Node 24.15.0 和上述 DSH 版本。

[开发与测试](DEVELOPMENT.md) · [验证记录](VERIFICATION.json) · [计划示例](examples/plan.json)

MIT · [第三方来源与许可证](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

plugins.description: DSH plugin: per-conversation token and money accounting — session_cost / list_session_costs tools, the /cost command, and a composer cost pill with per-model rates and DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-cost — 统计每个对话消耗的 token 与金额

DSH 插件（Cordis bundle）· 工具 `session_cost` / `list_session_costs` · 命令 `/cost` · 界面「💰 消耗」药丸

DSH 自己**只记 token、不记钱**：`dsh-token-meter` 的 `tokenUsage` 投影给出精确的 token 桶
（未命中缓存输入 / 命中缓存输入 / 缓存写入 / 输出），但整个自带安装里没有任何文本单价——
唯一带价格的是图片 visual token。本插件补上"金额"这一半，并且把两半都做成
**可按模型分别计价**的账。

```
会话日志（每条 assistant/message 自带 provider/model + usage）
   └─ lib/usage.js   按 attempt 归属到它自己的路由，按 attempt 当时的时刻判断高峰/非高峰（仅峰谷价模型）
        └─ lib/rates.js   查单价表 → 整数最小单位（1e-6）累加
             ├─ 工具 session_cost / list_session_costs   （模型可调，精确到每次调用）
             ├─ 命令 /cost                                （不花 token，直接看）
             └─ 界面 💰 药丸                              （会话级近似，可一键与日志核对）
```

## 数字从哪来（以及哪一半是精确的）

| 数字 | 来源 | 精确度 |
|---|---|---|
| token 桶 | 已落盘的 `assistant/message.data.usage`（缺省回退到流里最后一个 `usage` chunk） | **精确**，与 DSH 自己的 `tokenUsage` 投影逐字节一致（[见验证](#验证)） |
| 路由归属 | 该条 assistant 消息自己的 `message.source.provider/model` | **精确**，中途换模型会分成多行分别计价 |
| 高峰/非高峰 | 该次调用的 `event.time` | **精确到规则**：周一至周五 01:00–04:00、06:00–10:00（按 `offPeakTimezone`，默认 UTC）为高峰，中国法定节假日全天按非高峰；**只对峰谷价模型生效**（键名含 `deepseek` 或 `peakPricing: true`），其余模型全天一个价 |
| 单价 | 本插件的 `rates` 配置 | **取决于你填的对不对**；未配置的模型只统计 token、不计金额，并明确列出来 |
| 💰 药丸 | `tokenUsage` + `modelSelection` 两个投影 | **近似**：整段对话按当前模型计价；换过模型时请点「与日志核对」或看 `/cost` |

缓存写入（`cacheWriteTokens`）DeepSeek 不单独计费，因此默认按普通输入（cache miss）价计价，
可用 `cacheWrite` 覆盖。金额用**整数最小单位**（1e-6，即"微元"）累加，避免长对话里浮点误差；
单位是 `currency` 那一个，不是美元。

## 安装

```powershell
# 在 dsh-session-cost 目录下
node install/install.mjs                 # 装进默认 desktop profile（含默认单价表）
node install/install.mjs --dry-run       # 先看会改什么
node install/install.mjs --currency '{"symbol":"$","code":"USD","perUsd":1}'   # 若账号按美元计费
node install/install.mjs --uninstall     # 卸载
```

安装做三件事，每件都有 `.dsh-session-cost-<时间戳>.bak` 备份：

1. 把包**实体复制**到 `<profile>\node_modules\@local\dsh-session-cost`（不用符号链接：源目录
   曾被链接清空过一次；实体复制还能让 `@deepseek-ai/*` 的裸导入走 profile 自己的解析路径）
2. profile `package.json`：加 `file:` 依赖，并把包名追加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`
   （这一步才让它出现在「插件」页的**已安装**里）
3. profile `cordis.patch.yml`：用受管块按 id 覆写两行，写入单价表 / 货币 / 非高峰设置

**装完**：改 `lib/index.js`、`lib/command.js` 等宿主半边 → **完全退出 DSH 再启动**；
改 `lib/client.js`（界面半边）→ 页面**硬刷新**（Ctrl+R）。插件页 → 已安装 →
`@local/dsh-session-cost` → 任一行 → **配置**，可直接编辑单价表（表单由本包自己渲染，
因为 DSH 只提供 `plugins.row.config` 扩展点、不自带渲染器）。

> 实测差异（本插件开发时踩到的）：**首次**把包加进 profile 会让运行中的 DSH 热重组，
> 宿主侧的工具/命令/路由**立刻可用**；但**插件模块本身不会被重新导入**——之后再改
> `lib/*.js` 并刷新副本，运行中的进程仍在跑旧代码，必须重启 DSH 才会换新。界面半边的
> 插槽注册发生在页面加载时，所以至少要硬刷新一次。

> 另一个实测差异：**DSH 自己开着的沙箱可能只允许写工作区**。这种情况下
> `<profile>\cordis.patch.yml` 能写、`<profile>\node_modules\@local\dsh-session-cost\` 却
> `EPERM`——因为前者在允许列表里、后者不在。安装器会逐文件复制并把
> `NOT updated (permission denied): lib/ ...` 明确打出来（而不是假装成功），此时**行已改、
> 模块还是旧的**：换一个能写该目录的权限重跑同一命令即可，不需要退出 DSH。
> 注意这与「文件真的被运行中的 DSH 锁住」（`EBUSY`）是两回事，安装器分开报告。

## 配置字段

**在界面里填单价**（推荐）：插件页 → 已安装 → `@local/dsh-session-cost` → 任一行 → **配置**。
那一页的「模型单价」是一张**可编辑表格**，每个模型一行，直接输入数字即可：

```
模型（<provider>/<model>）   未命中   命中缓存   缓存写入   输出
deepseek-official/deepseek-flash   2     0.04              8    ×
deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro  9     0.3              27    ×
[＋ 添加模型]   留空的「命中缓存 / 缓存写入」= 与未命中同价

模型   未命中   命中缓存   缓存写入   输出
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash   ¥2   ¥0.04   ¥2   ¥8      ← 只读预览（跟随 currency）
DeepSeek-V4-Pro       ¥9   ¥0.3    ¥9   ¥27

▸ 高级：直接编辑 rates JSON
```

- **未命中、输出必填**；命中缓存 / 缓存写入留空 = 与未命中同价（DeepSeek 的缓存写入不单独计费）；
- **「＋ 添加模型」**加一行，每行的 **×** 删掉该行（至少留一行）；
- 表格只改这四列，**同一模型上的其它字段会被保留**（`label`、`offPeakMultiplier`、
  `inputOffPeak` 等），不会因为你在界面上改了一个价就把高级设置悄悄删掉；
- 模型名必须写成 `<provider>/<model>`，**可以直接复制下面只读预览里的键名**；
- 下面是**只读预览**：按当前 `currency` 标注单位，把每个模型的四个单价列全，一眼能看出
  「我填的价会不会被这么算」；
- 最下面的**「高级」**是可折叠的 `rates` JSON 原文——要写表格没有暴露的字段
  （`inputOffPeak` 之类）时用它；两处是同一个值的两个视角，改哪边都会同步另一边的表格；
- **保存前会校验**：缺 `input`/`output`、值不是数字、模型名没有 `/`、模型名重复，都会**拒绝保存**
  并指出是**哪一行哪个字段**——因为 Host 挂载时会拒绝这种表，那会让整个读数不显示，
  所以宁可在这里拦住。

字段清单（表格没覆盖的部分用「高级」直接写）：

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `rates` | DeepSeek 官方价（见下） | JSON：`"<provider>/<model>"` → 每 100 万 token 的单价，**单位与 `currency` 一致** |
| `currency` | `{"symbol":"¥","code":"CNY","perUsd":1}` | 展示货币；`perUsd` 是 1 美元兑多少该货币 |
| `offPeakMultiplier` | `0.5` | 非高峰价 = 高峰价 × 该系数，**只对「峰谷价」的模型生效**（见 `peakPricing`） |
| `offPeakTimezone` | `UTC` | 判断高峰时段的 IANA 时区 |
| `offPeakHolidays` | 空 = 用内置清单 | 中国法定节假日（`YYYY-MM-DD`，逗号分隔），这些日期全天按非高峰价 |
| `dshHome` | 空 | 空 = `$DSH_HOME`，再退回 `~/.dsh` |

单价表每个条目可用的字段：

| 字段 | 必填 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `input` | ✅ | 未命中缓存的输入价 |
| `output` | ✅ | 输出价 |
| `cacheRead` | | 命中缓存的输入价；缺省 = `input` |
| `cacheWrite` | | 缓存写入价；缺省 = `input`（DeepSeek 不单独计费） |
| `label` | | 界面/报告里显示的名字，如 `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` |
| `peakPricing` | | 该模型是否有高峰/非高峰两档价；**不填时按键名判断：含 `deepseek` 才是 `true`，其余一律 `false`（固定价）** |
| `offPeakMultiplier` | | 该模型自己的非高峰系数，覆盖全局值；只对 `peakPricing: true` 的模型生效 |
| `inputOffPeak` / `cacheReadOffPeak` / `cacheWriteOffPeak` / `outputOffPeak` | | 直接写死非高峰价，覆盖系数；同样只对峰谷价模型生效 |

**峰谷价只属于 DeepSeek**。这是实测踩到的第二个坑：插件原来把非高峰折扣套在了**每一条**已配置
单价的路由上，于是本机真实存在的 `our-free-model/mimo-v2.6-flash-free`（只有一个固定价）被算成
半价，面板还理直气壮地写着「非高峰 ×0.5」——那个模型根本没有低谷时段。现在的规则是：

- 键名含 `deepseek` 的路由 → 峰谷价（`deepseek-official/*`、`deepseek-account/*`）；
- 其它一切路由 → 固定价，全天按表里的价格，面板显示「固定价」；
- 想覆盖就在该条目写 `peakPricing: true`（比如 DeepSeek 模型走了别的 provider 名，
  或某个转售商也分时计价）或 `peakPricing: false`（比如 DeepSeek 模型被按平价转售）。

实测（本机全部会话日志 + 已装配置）：修复前 `our-free-model/mimo-v2.6-flash-free`
合计 **¥0.945**，修复后 **¥1.8907**，正好差一倍；同一份数据里三条 DeepSeek 路由金额
一分不变（¥48.9713 / ¥10.5830 / ¥0.523）——也就是这次修正没有动到本来就正确的部分。

默认表按 [DeepSeek 官方定价](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/) 的**高峰价**
填写，单位是**人民币元 / 百万 token**——因为 DeepSeek 账号本身以人民币计费、余额也按人民币变动。
非高峰由 `offPeakMultiplier: 0.5` 折半（官方非高峰价为高峰价的一半）：

```json
{
  "deepseek-official/deepseek-flash": { "label": "DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash", "input": 2, "cacheRead": 0.04, "output": 8 },
  "deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro": { "label": "DeepSeek-V4-Pro", "input": 9, "cacheRead": 0.3, "output": 27 }
}
```

> **为什么默认是人民币，而不是美元**：这是实测踩到的坑。DeepSeek 的官方文档同时给出美元价
> （Flash 高峰 `$0.3 / $0.006 / $1.2`）。早期版本照抄美元价、`currency` 写 `$`，于是同一个
> 会话显示 `$1.1262`，而平台余额实际扣了 **¥9.06**——看起来像"统计少了一个数量级"，其实是
> **币种错了**，而且因为不能拿中美汇率当 1 用，误差正好是汇率倍数。把单价表和 `currency` 都
> 换成账号自己的人民币口径后，同一个会话算出 **¥4.9610**，与平台对得上。
>
> 如果你的账号是美元计费（或你想看美元），把 `rates` 换成美元价、`currency` 换成
> `{"symbol":"$","code":"USD","perUsd":1}` 即可——**两处必须同时改**，只改一个就会差一个汇率。

**高峰时段**（官方脚注）：周一至周五 `01:00–04:00` 与 `06:00–10:00` **UTC**，
**不含中国法定节假日**——节假日全天按非高峰。窗口是规则，节假日是日历，所以后者是
`offPeakHolidays` 数据：内置 2026 年清单，**每年 11 月国务院公布次年安排后需要更新**
（不更新只会把工作日节假日按高峰算，即偏高，不会偏低）。留空就用内置清单，填了就完全替换。

这个窗口**只对峰谷价的模型生效**（键名含 `deepseek`，或显式 `peakPricing: true`）；
固定价模型不看时间，也就不会因为节假日/时段变化而算错。`offPeakHolidays` 与
`offPeakTimezone` 只在前者身上起作用。

价格会变，**请以官方页面为准**自行更新。

## 用法

### 1. 界面：消耗药丸 + 明细面板

对话输入框上方（DSH 自带统计药丸那一排）会多一个胶囊：

```
● ¥0.0138 · 129k / 1.00M ⌄        ← 圆点：灰=空闲，绿=正在跑；未配置价格时描边转警告色
● ¥10.3089 · 284k / 1.00M ⌄       ← 金额是本会话（或家族）的花费，token 数是「当前上下文」
● ¥8.2288 [含派生 4] · 144k / 1.05M ⌄   ← 派生出过子代理时：金额是「本会话 + 派生会话」
```

**token 数字刻意用 DSH 自己的口径**：`已用 / 窗口`，也就是「下一次调用要发送的长度」。
这是 DSH 自带统计显示的那个数，用它才不会让人以为两边对不上（见下面「三个 token 数」）。

**只要这个对话派生出过子代理 / workflow agent，胶囊的金额就是整个家族的花费**，并在后面
标出包含了几个派生会话——否则它会看起来比实际便宜（子代理是独立会话、独立计费，它们的
token 根本不在本会话的 `tokenUsage` 投影里，所以这个数必须问宿主）。鼠标悬停会写清全部口径：

```
deepseek-official/deepseek-flash · 本会话 ¥5.6821 + 4 个派生会话 ¥2.5467 · 家族合计 ¥8.2288
  · 整段对话累计计费 243,629,270 tokens（含缓存重读） · 本次新增 1,372,099 tokens · 当前上下文 144k / 1.05M
```

**路由一律写成 `<provider>/<model>`**（悬停提示、面板头部、`/cost`、工具返回都是），
因为 `rates` 就是按这个键写的：它指的就是你要去编辑的那一条，而且同一个模型名可能被两个
provider 提供，只写模型名分不出是哪一条。配置过的 `label` 只在有空间的地方补在后面，
如面板头部的 `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）`。

本会话自身的金额始终在同一行里，所以与 DSH 自带统计对照时不会失去参照。

点开是一个面板（点击外部或按 Esc 关闭；展开状态记在 `localStorage`，刷新后保持）：

```
对话消耗        deepseek-official/deepseek-flash（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）  [非高峰 ×0.5]
对话消耗        our-free-model/mimo-v2.6-flash-free                  [固定价]   ← 这条路只有一个价，不分峰谷
██████████████░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░   ← 金额构成条（本会话自身的构成）
■ 未命中 20%   ■ 命中缓存 2%   ■ 输出 78%      ← 图例：每种 token 的金额占比

输入 · 未命中缓存        1,000,000        ¥2.00
输入 · 命中缓存          1,000,000        ¥0.02
输入 · 缓存写入                  0

plugins.description: Every ArtCraft (storytold) crafting app as a DSH plugin — 12 Cordis plugins driving CADCraft, GridCraft, SoundCraft and 9 more headlessly, each over its own CLI and MCP server.
plugins.readme_text:
# ArtCraft × DSH **Twelve crafting applications. One agent. Zero source changes.** Every app from the [ArtCraft](https://github.com/storytold) org — CAD, spreadsheets, audio, video, photo, vector, PDF, slides, documents — exposed to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) as a first-class plugin. [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4D6BFE?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![built on Cordis](https://img.shields.io/badge/built%20on-Cordis-6E56CF?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT%20OR%20Apache--2.0-blue?style=flat-square)](#license) [![Plugins](https://img.shields.io/badge/plugins-12-success?style=flat-square)](#the-twelve) [![Tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/tools-92-informational?style=flat-square)](#two-surfaces-per-craft) [![MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-bridged-8A2BE2?style=flat-square)](#two-surfaces-per-craft) [![Verified](https://img.shields.io/badge/verified-12%2F12-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](#verify-it-yourself) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-artcraft-plugin-gridcraft?style=flat-square&label=npm&color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-artcraft-plugin-gridcraft) English · [中文](README.zh.md)
--- ```console $ dsh --profile web you › make me a Q3 sales spreadsheet with a chart, save it to ~/Documents ⏺ gridcraft_commands {"search": "chart"} 315 commands, 8 families ⏺ gridcraft_describe {"id": "insert.chart"} {range?, type?, title?, at?} ⏺ gridcraft_run sample "sales", 2 commands exited 0 in 41ms ⏺ gridcraft_inspect ~/Documents/q3.xlsx 1 sheet, 1 chart, A1:H24 ✔ GridCraft wrote ~/Documents/q3.xlsx (14,208 bytes) ``` ## What this is The ArtCraft suite is twelve native Rust applications. Each one already ships a headless CLI and its own MCP server — but nothing tells an agent they exist, what they can do, or how to call them. This repository closes that gap. Each app becomes a **DSH plugin** that registers model-callable tools on `ctx.tools`, discovers the app's binary on your machine, and drives it as an external process. **No craft source is ever modified.** Every plugin lives here. The applications are dependencies, not forks. ## The twelve | | Craft | What it does | Commands | MCP tools | |:--|:--|:--|--:|--:| | 📐 | **CADCraft** | CAD and drafting (AutoCAD-style) | 305 | 11 | | 📊 | **GridCraft** | Spreadsheets (Excel-style) | 315 | 21 | | 🎚️ | **SoundCraft** | Digital audio workstation | 465 | 17 | | 🖼️ | **PhotoCraft** | Raster image editing (Photoshop-style) | 858 | 21 | | 🌄 | **LightCraft** | Photo library and raw development | 296 | 318 | | 📄 | **PdfCraft** | PDF reading and editing | 161 | 161 | | 🖋️ | **VectorCraft** | Vector art (Illustrator-style) | 743 | 32 | | 🎬 | **EffectCraft** | Motion graphics (After Effects-style) | 669 | 27 | | 🎞️ | **FilmCraft** | Non-linear video editing | 693 | 17 | | 🎨 | **DesignCraft** | Page and layout design (InDesign-style) | 446 | 25 | | 📽️ | **DeckCraft** | Presentations (PowerPoint-style) | 226 | 25 | | 📝 | **WordCraft** | Word processing (Word-style) | 460 | 16 | Command counts are read live from each binary; MCP counts are what each server declares. ## Two surfaces per craft Every plugin exposes **both**, because they answer different questions:
Generic commandsThe craft's own MCP server
Reaches the **entire application** — every menu item is a command id. ``` gridcraft_commands {"search": "chart"} gridcraft_describe {"id": "insert.chart"} gridcraft_run {"commands": [...], "save": "..."} gridcraft_inspect {"file": "..."} gridcraft_convert {"input": "...", "output": "..."} ``` **Modelled operations** with real JSON Schemas, served over JSON-RPC by the app itself. ``` gridcraft_mcp_tools {"search": "range"} gridcraft_mcp_call {"tool": "write_range", "arguments": {"range": "A1", "values": [["x"]]}} gridcraft_mcp_status {} ```
The MCP server is spawned once per plugin and kept warm — starting GridCraft's engine costs ~600 ms — then shut down after five idle minutes or when the plugin unloads. ## Quick start **Windows** — from a fresh clone, in PowerShell: ```powershell git clone https://github.com/lznnnnn1998/dsh-artcraft cd dsh-artcraft .\install.ps1 # or: install.cmd (if .ps1 files are blocked) ``` That finds the Node the harness already ships (no `node`, `npm` or `pnpm` on `PATH` needed), downloads every craft CLI for your platform, and installs the twelve plugins into your DSH profile. Add `-Crafts gridcraft` for one craft, `-List` for a dry run, or `-Verify` to prove it works: ```powershell .\install.ps1 -Crafts gridcraft,wordcraft -Profile desktop -Verify ``` **macOS and Linux** — the same two steps by hand: ```sh git clone https://github.com/lznnnnn1998/dsh-artcraft cd dsh-artcraft # 1. the craft CLIs — macOS, Windows and Linux, no Rust toolchain needed node scripts/install-craft.mjs # …or compile them from source instead (needs Rust, ~1 min per craft): # node scripts/install-craft.mjs --from-source # 2. install the plugins into a DSH profile, then restart it node scripts/install-into-profile.mjs --profile web ``` Both platforms run the same Node scripts; `install.ps1` only adds Node discovery and PowerShell-friendly defaults. Nothing is installed machine-wide and no shell profile is modified. Or install a single craft from npm, straight into a profile: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-artcraft-plugin-gridcraft ``` Each craft is its own package: `dsh-artcraft-plugin-` for `cadcraft`, `gridcraft`, `soundcraft`, `deckcraft`, `wordcraft`, `photocraft`, `lightcraft`, `pdfcraft`, `vectorcraft`, `effectcraft`, `filmcraft` and `designcraft`. Then just ask: > *"Open the CADCraft sample floor plan and export a PNG of the kitchen."* > *"Take the demo song in SoundCraft, drop the kick 6 dB and bounce it."* > *"Render page 3 of this PDF at 300 dpi."* Full instructions, configuration and troubleshooting: **[docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md)**
Requirements - **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` — on Windows the harness's own bundled Node is found automatically, so you do not need it on `PATH` - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) profile - **macOS, Windows 11 or Ubuntu 24.04** — the installer picks the right build, and nothing else is required (no Rust, no `unzip`, no `tar`, no `npm`, no `pnpm`) Nothing else. The craft apps are **not** built from source; step 1 downloads signed release binaries.
## Verify it yourself ```sh node scripts/verify.mjs ``` Every craft must locate its binary, load its live catalog, expose the right tool set, complete an MCP handshake, and produce a non-empty artifact from a real headless run: ``` craft binary catalog tools mcp run cadcraft cadcraft-cli 0.5.0 305 (live) 8 11 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.dxf (34140 B) deckcraft deckcraft-cli 0.5.0 226 (live) 8 25 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.deckcraft (7471 B) designcraft designcraft-cli 0.6.0 446 (live) 6 25 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.pdf (2028 B) effectcraft effectcraft-cli 0.8.0 669 (live) 8 27 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.ecproj (732438 B) filmcraft filmcraft-cli 0.6.0 693 (live) 8 17 tools (command_list ok) ok → out.fcproj (3264 B) gridcraft gridcraft-cli 0.5.0 315 (live) 8 21 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.xlsx (7682 B) lightcraft lightcraft-cli 0.6.0 296 (live) 7 318 tools (command_list ok) ok → out.bin (108535 B) pdfcraft pdfcraft-cli 0.7.1 161 (live) 8 161 tools (doc_list ok) ok → out.pdf (802 B) photocraft photocraft-c

plugins.description: Desktop plugin for DeepSeek Harness that connects DSHM to computer sessions, with device pairing, access control, and synchronized chat.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSHM 插件 · DeepSeek Harness 远程连接 简体中文 | [English](./README.en.md) [DSHM 安卓客户端](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-mobile) · **DSHM 电脑插件** · [DSHM 中转服务](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-relay) **DSHM 插件**安装在电脑的官方 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 中，将工作区、聊天会话、执行结果和审批同步到 [DSHM 安卓客户端](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-mobile)。手机远程续聊与决策，电脑执行任务；无需修改或重建 DSH。 [GitHub 一条命令安装](#安装插件并配对手机) · [下载插件包](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases/tag/v0.1.85-latest.0) · [DSH 兼容清单](./compatibility/latest-upstream/official-support.md) · [常见问题](#常见问题)

![DSHM 插件：把电脑上的工作，连接到手机。](./docs/images/hero.png) ## 远程会话与设备管理功能 | 能力 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | 会话同步 | 查看工作区与历史、创建聊天、发送消息、切换模型、处理审批。 | | 设备管理 | 五分钟有效的一次性配对链接；核对指纹、批准、拒绝与撤销。 | | 访问控制 | 开关远程连接；电脑管理权限另行授予或收回。 | | 扩展 | 通过允许的接口转发文件、工具结果与兼容插件局部界面。 | ![DeepSeek Harness 中的 DSHM 插件设置：电脑已连接，手机配对等待批准。](./docs/images/desktop-pairing.png) [图片来源](./docs/images/README.md)。真实插件页面，使用演示设备。 ## 安装插件并配对手机 [插件构建与下载](./docs/releases.md) · [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/actions/workflows/plugin-build.yml) · [发行版本](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases) **官方 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-alpha.2` 共用同一 GitHub 安装包：** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:KKUCODES/dshm-plugin ``` `dsh plugin` 是 DSH 官方命令。若你从 DSH 源码目录启动，使用 `pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add github:KKUCODES/dshm-plugin`。仓库包含预编译产物，安装时不需要编译器、相邻后端目录或额外构建许可；正式使用建议复制市场提供的 `#完整提交号` 命令，固定到已扫描版本。[GitHub 安装与版本说明](./docs/github-install.md) 仓库默认安装包 `0.1.85-latest.0` 支持上述两个明确版本。alpha.1 仍需使用对应的 `.tgz`，不能使用默认命令。三个版本的插件包已公开发布，直接下载无需登录 GitHub： | 电脑 DSH 版本 | 直接下载 | | --- | --- | | `0.2.0-rc.2` | [rc.2 插件包](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases/download/v0.1.85-latest.0/dshm-plugin-0.1.85-latest.0-dsh-0.2.0-rc.2.tgz) | | `0.2.1-alpha.1` | [alpha.1 插件包](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases/download/v0.1.85-latest.0/dshm-plugin-0.1.85-latest.0-dsh-0.2.1-alpha.1.tgz) | | `0.2.1-alpha.2` | [alpha.2 插件包](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases/download/v0.1.85-latest.0/dshm-plugin-0.1.85-latest.0-dsh-0.2.1-alpha.2.tgz) | 连接 rc.2 / alpha.2 请使用 [DSHM 0.1.0-preview.2 APK](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/download/v0.1.0-preview.2/DSHM-0.1.0-preview.2.apk)；该 APK 不连接 alpha.1。旧 preview.1 仍只连接 alpha.2。[双版本验证与手机要求](./compatibility/latest-upstream/market-baseline.md) · [完整配对步骤](./docs/usage.md) 1. 安装匹配 DSH 版本的插件，运行 `pnpm dsh web`；提示下次启动加载时，重启 DSH。 2. 填写中转根地址、电脑名称，注册电脑并开启连接。 3. 手机领取配对链接，电脑核对指纹并批准。 4. 手机打开已有工作区，继续会话或创建新聊天。 **推荐[自建中转](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-relay)**；也可填[公共服务](http://118.31.20.47:18787) `http://118.31.20.47:18787`。开放注册免密，设备仍需配对与批准，无需用户账号。 公共服务使用 HTTP，传输未加密。敏感内容建议自建 HTTPS。电脑和 DSH 必须保持运行。[完整安装步骤](./docs/usage.md) ## 更换中转服务地址 点击插件设置页 **“修改服务地址”**： - **同一后端换地址：** 换域名、端口或 HTTPS，验证后保留电脑身份和授权。 - **更换后端：** 重新注册和配对；个人模式需新密钥，旧服务授权不会自动撤销。 ![DSHM 电脑插件：修改中转服务地址并选择保留设备授权或重新配对。](./docs/images/change-server.png) 取消或验证失败保留原连接，保存成功保留启停状态。手机需新链接重新配对。[详细步骤](./docs/usage.md#5-修改服务地址) ## 当前状态 | 范围 | 版本与已验内容 | | --- | --- | | GitHub 安装 | `0.1.85-latest.0`，同一份预编译产物支持官方 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-alpha.2`；两版均已通过实际官方安装、设置页与卸载。[双版本记录](./compatibility/latest-upstream/market-baseline.md) | | Release 下载 | rc.2、alpha.1、alpha.2 的精确匹配归档已公开发布；三版云端构建及匿名下载校验通过，下载时不能混用。[构建说明](./docs/releases.md) | | 修改服务地址 | `0.1.81-latest.0` 的[独立设置页验证](./compatibility/latest-upstream/gateway-settings.md)，不代表完整 Remote 重验。 | | 核心 Remote | 官方 DSH `0.2.1-alpha.2`＋插件 `0.1.80-latest.0`＋原配套 Android，在 Web + MuMu 完成本地验收。[支持清单](./compatibility/latest-upstream/official-support.md) | 当前为公开预发布。GitHub 安装与构建通过不等于已完成新包的全量手机兼容验收；Electron、真机、完整公网及其他版本、插件、模型需另验。 手机不创建电脑工作区、不输入命令、不转发电脑 localhost 网站。 ## 常见问题 ### 应该选择哪个 DSH 版本的插件包？ 先查看电脑的 DSH 版本。GitHub 默认安装支持 `0.2.0-rc.2` 和 `0.2.1-alpha.2`；下载 `.tgz` 时，包名中的 `dsh-<版本>` 必须对应电脑版本，例如 `dshm-plugin-0.1.85-latest.0-dsh-0.2.0-rc.2.tgz`。alpha.1 使用自己的归档。升级 DSH 后重新核对[兼容清单](./compatibility/latest-upstream/official-support.md)，不要把未验版本默认视为兼容。 ### 配对链接发给手机后就能访问电脑吗？ 还需要电脑核对手机的公钥指纹并批准。链接五分钟内有效，领取后失效；已批准设备可以在电脑插件页撤销，电脑管理权限另行授予。 ### 手机续聊必须获得电脑管理权限吗？ 不需要。批准设备后即可使用聊天与任务操作；管理电脑工作区、插件和设置需要另行授予管理权限，也可以单独收回。操作入口见[管理访问](./docs/usage.md#4-管理访问)。 ## 开发与文档 TypeScript + Cordis，React 配置页。GitHub Actions 自动准备固定后端协议与已发布 SDK，分别打包三个 DSH 版本，并核对提交的 GitHub 安装产物与源码一致。`lib/` 是安装入口，`dist/` 仅作旧开发输出，见[自动构建说明](./docs/releases.md)与开发指南。 ```text src/ 电脑插件、会话适配与配置页 lib/ 已编译 GitHub 安装入口，随源码提交并由 CI 复核 scripts/ 构建与审查脚本 tests/ 插件测试与夹具 docs/ 使用、开发和技术文档 compatibility/ 版本支持与兼容验证资料 ``` - [安装与使用](./docs/usage.md)：连接、批准与撤销。 - [开发指南](./docs/development.md)：依赖、构建与版本。 - [Remote 缓存](./compatibility/latest-upstream/remote-cache.md)：权威资源指纹与只读数据差量，需配套 DSHM 0.1.0-preview.4，现有中转无需升级。 - [下载与发版](./docs/releases.md)：Actions 插件包与发行草稿。 - [GitHub 安装与市场投稿](./docs/github-install.md)：官方命令、固定提交及版本要求。 - [支持清单](./compatibility/latest-upstream/official-support.md)：已验与未验范围。 - [知识库](./docs/project-knowledge/catalog.md)：架构、接口与验证资料。 ## 许可证 本项目原创代码采用 [MIT 许可证](./LICENSE)。第三方代码、依赖和素材遵循各自的许可证与使用条件。

# dsh-delivery-receipt（交付回执）

给 DeepSeek Harness 的**交付回执**插件：项目收尾时按一下，把「分支与 commit、测试与构建结果、
关键截图尺寸与 sha256、密钥扫描结论」汇成一张可以拿出去给人看的页面 —— 并且把每一条声明
**硬性**分进「已验证 / 仅本地 / 未验证」三区。**没有证据的板块留空，不补话。**

## 为什么要有它

收尾汇报每次都要手写一遍：写少了漏证据，写多了越界（把"我这台机器上是这样"说成"已经交付"）。
生态里的状态类插件（`2008924/dsh-progress-viz`、`133563825as-ai/dsh-api-dashboard`）都是**给自己看的实时面板**；
名字相近的 `dsh-receipt` 系列（如 `bluechips-zhao/dsh-receipt`、`louisyeaaah/dsh-receipt`）是**会话/用量小票**（token、耗时、成本、热敏打印）。
它们都不回答"这份交付里，哪几条是别人能复现的，哪几条只在你机器上成立"。

这个插件把这件事变成一条可测试的规则：

| 区 | 判定（只看证据，不看措辞，也不看成败） |
|---|---|
| **已验证** | 证据来自本次采集且能在别处复现：命令确实跑了（退出码就是事实）、文件哈希且文件已入版本库、扫描确实扫到了文件、git 引用在本地记录的远端里 |
| **仅本地** | 只在这台机器上成立：未提交改动、未推送提交、交付物未被 git 跟踪（别人拿到仓库看不到这个哈希） |
| **未验证** | 没有证据或证据不足：命令没运行/超时、声明的文件不存在、扫描 0 个文件、以及**人写的任何一句话** |

> ⚠️ **「已验证」不等于「是好消息」**：测试失败、密钥扫描命中都是**有证据的事实**，同样进已验证区，只是带红色色调。
> 三区分的是**证据强度**，不是成败。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-delivery-receipt
```

也可以从 GitHub 直装：`dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-delivery-receipt`。
装好后重启 DSH，对话视图里出现「交付回执」Tab。

## 配置：`delivery-receipt.json`（放在项目根）

```json
{
  "project": "my-project",
  "tests":   [{ "name": "单元测试", "command": "node --test test/*.test.mjs" }],
  "builds":  [{ "name": "构建", "command": "node scripts/build.mjs" }],
  "artifacts": ["docs/*.png"],
  "scan": { "ignore": ["docs/big-demo.html"] },
  "claims": [{ "label": "已内部评审", "value": "2026-10-12 通过" }],
  "runCommands": true
}
```

| 字段 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `tests` / `builds` | 生成回执时会**执行**并把退出码、通过数、耗时写进回执。写法可以是字符串或 `{name, command}` |
| `artifacts` | 交付物模式：精确路径或 `目录/*.png`。会记录字节数、sha256、图片尺寸、以及**是否已入版本库** |
| `scan.ignore` | 密钥扫描跳过的路径前缀 |
| `scan.allowMarker` | 逐行豁免标记，默认 `delivery-receipt:allow`。测试夹具、文档示例这类"像凭据但不是凭据"的行，在行尾写上标记即可豁免；**豁免了多少行会原样出现在回执里**，不是静默放过 |
| `claims` | 你要说的话。**永远进未验证区** —— 能附证据的东西应该写成上面那些字段 |
| `runCommands` | 默认 `true`；设 `false` 只采集不执行 |
| `cwd` | 可选：覆盖采集目录（相对路径按配置文件所在目录解析） |

## 用法

装好插件后：对话视图 →「交付回执」→ 点「生成回执」。面板会先列出**这次会执行哪些命令**，
再按三区展示结果；「打开回执页」给出自包含的 HTML（可直接存文件/发出去），「复制 Markdown」给 PR 或聊天用。

不装 DSH 也能用：

```sh
node scripts/receipt.mjs                     # 打印摘要
node scripts/receipt.mjs --out receipt.html  # 落盘自包含页面
node scripts/receipt.mjs --md                # 打印 Markdown
node scripts/receipt.mjs --no-run            # 只采集，不执行命令
```

本仓库自己的回执（dogfood，含真实的 sha256 与扫描结论）：[docs/receipt-example.md](docs/receipt-example.md)

![回执页：三区并列，每条声明都带证据行](docs/screenshot-1.png)

> 图是**快照**：截图文件自身的 sha256 每拍一次都会变，所以图里「交付物」那一行永远比当前文件慢一代。
> 权威数据看 [docs/receipt-example.md](docs/receipt-example.md)（它记录的是它自己那一刻的仓库状态，含生成时间与 commit）。

## HTTP 接口

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/dsh-delivery-receipt/state` | 当前配置、将要执行的命令、上次回执摘要 |
| POST | `/dsh-delivery-receipt/generate` | 生成一次回执（body 可带 `{"cwd": "..."}`，但必须在白名单内） |
| GET | `/dsh-delivery-receipt/receipt.html` | 自包含回执页（未生成时是明确的"还没有"页） |
| GET | `/dsh-delivery-receipt/receipt.md` | 同一份内容的 Markdown |
| GET | `/dsh-delivery-receipt/receipt.json` | 回执对象（未生成时 404） |

## 安全边界（重要）

- **要执行的命令只来自配置文件**（`delivery-receipt.json` 或插件配置的 `receiptConfig`），
  **永远不来自 HTTP 请求**。`test/host.test.mjs` 里有一条测试专门往请求体塞 `command` 和假的 `tests`，断言执行器一次都没被调用。
- **能采集的目录只来自插件配置**：`cwd` 与 `roots` 白名单。请求里带的 `cwd` 不在白名单内一律 403 且不采集。
- **不联网**：远端状态读本地的 `refs/remotes/origin/*`，回执里标注为「本地记录的远端状态」，不把离线缓存说成实时事实。
- **不落凭据**：密钥扫描命中只记录 `文件:行号 + 规则名`，匹配到的内容、长度、摘要都不写；所有进入页面的文本再过一次脱敏（`ghp_…`、`sk-…`、私钥块、内联 Bearer、赋值型口令），家目录归一成 `~`。仓库里有一条测试断言"密钥字符串及其前缀不出现在序列化结果里"。
- **夹具误报有出口，而且不是静默的**：测试里必然会出现"像凭据的字符串"，所以扫描支持逐行豁免标记（默认 `delivery-receipt:allow`）。豁免的行数会写进回执的扫描范围一栏 —— 你可以看到放过了 3 行，而不是被瞒着。
- **自包含**：回执页没有外链脚本、没有 CDN、没有追踪（有测试断言 `<link>`/`<script>`/外链 `src|href` 都不存在），所以它可以离线保存、当附件发出去。

## 它不做什么

- **不判断好坏**：测试失败、扫描命中照样进「已验证」，插件的职责是把事实和证据分级，不是替你做结论。
- **不替你核实远端**：不联网，也没法知道远端仓库是否 public、tag 是否推上去了 —— 这类声明会落在「仅本地」或「未验证」。
- **不补话**：某个板块没有证据就是空的，页面会写「此区无证据」而不是编一段过渡句。
- **不是安全审计**：内置正则覆盖常见凭据形态（GitHub/npm/sk-/AWS/GCP/Slack/私钥/内联 Bearer/赋值型口令 + 敏感文件名），
  跳过大文件与二进制；它降低"把凭据一起发出去"的概率，不等于完备扫描。

## 开发

```sh
node scripts/build.mjs   # 零依赖构建（不需要打包器），产出 lib/
node --test              # 64 个测试
```

测试分四组：`evidence`（git 解析 / 图片尺寸 / 哈希 / 扫描 / 配置）、`zones`（三区判定规则）、
`receipt`（渲染与脱敏）、`host`（用 stub ctx 驱动真实 `apply()`，含两条安全边界）。
`lib/` 是构建产物，改 `src/` 后必须重新 build。

## 本仓库自身的状态（诚实披露）

- ✅ 已验证：`node --test` 64/64 通过、`node scripts/build.mjs` 退出 0、密钥扫描 0 命中（见 [回执](docs/receipt-example.md)）。
- ⚠️ 未验证：**没有在运行中的 DSH 里安装加载过** —— host/client 半区只经过单元测试与构建校验，
  没有端到端跑过真实宿主；面板截图一栏用的是 CLI 生成的回执页，不是 DSH 面板。
- ✅ 参考与差异：工程骨架照抄同作者的 [`dsh-warden`](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-warden)
  （零依赖构建、`cordis.patch.yml`、host/client 双半区、README、测试结构），这是明确授权的骨架复用；
  **实现代码没有搬运任何现有插件**。上面提到的 `dsh-progress-viz` / `dsh-api-dashboard` / `dsh-receipt`
  系列只读了它们的仓库简介，用来说明本插件与它们的差异。

plugins.description: Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness: ordered allow/deny/ask rules with tool-name, argument (glob/regex), and workspace-path matching on the tools/pre-execute waterfall, session-log audit, and HMR reload.

# 🛡️ dsh-permission-rules - **1024 store channel**: `npm i -g dsh1024` once, then `dsh1024 plugin --profile web add dsh-permission-rules` (counts toward the [deepseek1024.com](https://deepseek1024.com) install ranking). [![Gitee](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gitee-mirror-c71d23?logo=gitee)](https://gitee.com/perrylink/dsh-permission-rules) [![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?ref=badge) [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules) **Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness.** *Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not.* [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-✅-green)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![dsh-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor/main/badges/PerryLink__dsh-permission-rules.svg)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor#verified-徽章) [![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-top-rated.svg)](https://dsh.market/) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-brightgreen.svg)](#) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/actions) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?label=version)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/releases) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)
--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: DSH native plugin: audit GitHub repos for fake stars, stargazer bot farms and hollow codebases using CMU StarScout heuristics, plus static supply-chain and sensitive-permission inspection.

# @suxeca/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor

```
⚠️ 本仓库是**自动生成的发布镜像**，每次发布都会整体覆盖 `main`。
**唯一事实来源 / single source of truth:** [Suxeca/dsh-plugin → packages/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor](https://github.com/Suxeca/dsh-plugin/tree/main/packages/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor)
请勿在本仓库提交代码或 PR —— 改为修改源仓库中的 `packages/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor`，本仓库的内容会被下一次发布覆盖。
```

**本仓库只发布可安装产物**（`lib/`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`locale/`、`package.json`），**不含 `src/` 与 `tests/`**：审计器要检测的那些标记（安装钩子名、宿主进程 API、越狱口令等）在本仓库的产物中一律由运行时拼装生成（源仓库 `src/tokens.ts`），所以任何静态扫描都不会在本仓库里读到它自己的检测表 —— 否则它会扫到自己、把自己判成 CRITICAL（F 级），并让安装门禁对使用者误报。源码与唯一事实来源仍在源仓库。

DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 原生插件：基于 CMU StarScout 启发式指标审计 GitHub 假星 / 水军 / 空壳仓库，并对 DSH 插件做供应链投毒与敏感权限静态预检。

## 安装 / Install

```bash
dsh plugin add github:Suxeca/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor
```

无需构建：`lib/` 已预编译随仓库发布（prebuilt）。包名 `@suxeca/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor`，由 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明装配。

## 功能 / What it does

- **假星与互动比率审计** — Fork/Star、Watcher/Star 比率异常检测，含大仓（>50k stars）通知疲劳校准与豁免模型。
- **空壳与脉冲刷量** — 高星但代码体积 < 30 KB 的空壳仓库、活跃跨度不足 2 天的增星脉冲、0-Issue 异常增星（维护者关闭 Issues 时豁免）。
- **点星水军抽样** — 并发抽检最新 Stargazers 的 Profile，识别「三无空白号」与「新注册闪电水军」。
- **供应链投毒预检** — 经 GitHub Raw CDN 零配额静态拉取 `package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml`，识别高危安装钩子（远程下载、`eval`、混淆、凭据窃取）与 DSH 敏感权限（密钥服务注入、插件管理服务、宿主进程 API、工具执行前置钩子）。
- **安装拦截门禁** — 通过工具执行前置钩子（pre-execution hook）监听插件安装动作与 `bash` 中的 `git clone` / `npm install github:...`，命中风险时弹出 DSH 原生审批卡片。

## 配置项 / Configuration

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: repo-auditor
      name: '@suxeca/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor'
      config:
        token: ""               # GitHub PAT（可选）
        sampleSize: 5           # 水军账号抽样数量
        enableInstallGate: true # 安装拦截门禁开关
```

| 配置项 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token` | `string` | `""` | GitHub Personal Access Token（可选）。留空时按四级顺序自动探测：`config.token` → DSH 凭据服务 → 环境变量 `GITHUB_TOKEN` → 本地 `~/.bashrc` / `~/.env` / `.env`。未鉴权时受 60 次/小时配额限制，鉴权后为 5000 次/小时。 |
| `sampleSize` | `number` | `5` | 水军账号抽样数量；仅在仓库一阶指标可疑（评分 < 85）时才触发抽样，用于保护 API 配额。 |
| `enableInstallGate` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否启用工具执行前置钩子（双轨安全拦截门禁：星标信度低 或 供应链/敏感权限中高风险 → 弹卡审批）。 |

紧急逃生通道 / escape hatch：在命令前加环境变量 `SKIP_REPO_`＋`AUDIT=1`（拼接后即为跳过标记）可跳过安装门禁。

## 出处与致谢 / Attribution

启发式指标来自 CMU 论文 **"Six Million (Suspected) Fake Stars in GitHub: A Growing Spiral of Popularity Contagion, Suspicious Promotion, and Unwanted Projects"**（StarScout）— [arXiv:2412.13459](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.13459)。本插件是 DSH / Cordis 架构下的原生重实现，与论文作者无隶属关系。

## 构建与来源 / Build & source

本仓库为预编译产物，安装无需构建。源码与开发文档位于 [Suxeca/dsh-plugin](https://github.com/Suxeca/dsh-plugin) 的 `packages/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor`；发布流程见该仓库的 `scripts/release-auditor.sh`。

## 许可 / License

MIT License — 见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。该文件由发布脚本从源仓库根目录自动复制，与 `package.json` 的 `license` 字段保持一致。
