plugins.description: Mark things on a picture and look at the picture: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns an image into a record of numbered marks, with coordinate-labelled close-ups and comparison sheets you can check.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vision-reasoner

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets a model put numbered marks on a picture and
look at what it drew. A place is named in the picture's own pixels, read off a
labelled grid, so nothing is converted from a preview and no call has to be
expressed in the terms of an earlier one. It is not specific to any kind of
picture: counting the people in a photograph is one use, checking which of two
similar regions a note meant is another.

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `camera_reset` | Point the camera at the whole picture — one square window holding all of it, the picture drawn inside and the rest black — and see it. |
| `camera_move` | `step: "next"` walks the sweep in reading order, `"previous"` steps back, a direction steps one whole window, and `to: [x, y]` centres the window on a place read off the grid. |
| `camera_zoom_in` / `camera_zoom_out` | One ×2 or ÷2 step each, about the centre, `times` for several at once. The camera stays where it is left. |
| `mark_add` | Mark places by their coordinates, `at: [x, y]` in original pixels, with a radius `r`, a caption and a colour. The camera moves to the batch and the answer is a window around it. |
| `mark_remove` | Delete marks by number, e.g. `[3, 7]`, when a mark is in the wrong place. |
| `mark_edit` | Move, resize, recaption or recolour marks by number, in one call. |

Every picture comes back with a grid whose lines sit at round positions in the
picture's own pixels — 100, 200, 500, depending on how closely it is being looked
at — and every line is labelled with that number along all four edges. A number the
model reads is a number it can use. Every result also lists the whole record, with
the coordinates of every mark, so a mark placed twice, or in the wrong spot, is
visible in the next answer rather than several calls later. The tools never count
or judge what is in a picture: that is the model's statement to make.

The package also publishes a skill, `vision-sweep-count`: the workflow this tool set was
built around — see the whole picture, sweep it window by window, mark as you read, read the
window that comes back, count the record. A model reads a skill when a task matches one, which
matters here because pointing inside reasoning is a mode a model does not enter on its own.

## Install

```
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-vision-reasoner
```

Or from the Web UI: **Plugins → Add plugin**, with the package name. The package
declares `dsh.bundle.patch` → `./cordis.patch.yml` (one Host row), which the
profile loader applies the next time the profile loads. There is no build step and
no install script.

The only dependency is [`sharp`](https://sharp.pixelplumbing.com/) (Apache-2.0),
which the harness already uses for every image a session attaches
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment-local` depends on it), so a deployment that can run
this plugin already has it. Nothing third-party is vendored: the icon and the two
locale files are this package's own. Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.

## How it is used

1. **Look first.** A place is named from what has been seen, and the tool
   descriptions say so before anything else. The grid on the returned picture is
   the only ruler: the picture is not cropped with another tool, and no position is
   read off another view of it, whose pixels are a different size.
2. **Read the labels.** The lines are at round numbers of original pixels, so a
   position is read by naming the line before a feature and estimating the gap —
   about a quarter of a step is as fine as the eye goes, which is why the grid steps
   finer as the view gets closer.
3. **Mark the coordinates.** `mark_add` takes `at: [x, y]`, a radius `r` in the
   picture's own pixels, a caption and a colour. The camera moves to what was marked
   and the answer is a square window around those marks, with a cross at each centre
   and the record beside it.
4. **Sweep in windows you keep.** `camera_zoom_in` until a face is big enough to read,
   then walk the picture with `camera_move` and `step: "next"`: the windows tile the
   picture from its centre, "next" goes left to right and then down, and every result
   says how far the sweep has got and which windows are left. A place read in a window
   already used is comparable with the last one.
5. **Check, then correct.** The marks are drawn in every view, so what is left unmarked
   in the window in front of you is what you have not dealt with, and the record beside
   it shows a number twice or a ring on nothing. `mark_edit` moves a mark that is nearly
   right and `mark_remove` deletes one that is not — at once, since a change comes back
   as a window around what it touched and a wrong ring misleads every view after it.

## Behaviour

**The record is not written to disk.** Marks live in the session log. The harness
logs every tool call with its arguments and its result, and the record is a fold of
those events, rebuilt with the same pure functions the live call used. A call
carries everything the fold needs — a place is a pair of pixels, a radius is a number
of pixels, and the camera is a list of ways it was aimed — so a reopened session recovers the
same record, and nothing appears beside your picture.

**Each picture is written twice.** The model receives an image block through the
attachment service, the shape `read_image` sends, so the picture arrives with the
call that drew it. The Web UI's preview needs a file, because it decides how to
render a document from its extension and an attachment object has none; the PNG is
therefore also written to `<cwd>/.dsh-vision/<name>.png` and reported
workspace-relative in `images[].path`. That directory is the only thing this plugin
writes, and only when there is a picture to show.

**A missing picture is reported, not thrown.** No attachment service, or a model
that does not declare image input (the gate `read_image` applies), returns the text
plus a note instead of an image block; so does a failed write. Anything merely
unknown — an unresolvable route, an adapter error — attaches anyway, because
withholding a picture over a failed lookup costs more than it protects.

**Pictures are read through `ctx.fs`**, so the sandbox decides what may be read.

## The grid

- Lines sit at multiples of a round step — 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500 … — chosen as
  the coarsest step whose labels are still about 100 view pixels apart. A wide view
  and a close view therefore both stay readable, and neither changes what a number
  means.
- Every label is an original-image coordinate, on all four edges, whatever the view
  is. Nothing is scaled, and nothing has to be converted.
- Lines are drawn 2 pixels wide at minimum and scale with the view, because a
  one-pixel line is gone by the time the attachment pipeline has re-encoded the
  picture.
- Every view is rendered at the same longest side, so looking at a rectangle is
  never coarser than looking at the whole picture.
- The camera is a place, not an action. A look shows what is in front of the lens, `zoom` and
  `move` aim it, `reset` points it back at the whole picture, and every result says where it is —
  so a caller reads "closer, a little left" rather than inventing rectangles, and looking again
  needs no arguments at all.
- Marks are drawn by default, so the picture carries the record; `marks: false` gives a clean
  canvas for counting a place again from scratch.
- Every result counts the windows the camera has **stopped in** since the last reset, names the
  one it is in, and names the ones still left: an unswept corner is a word in the answer rather
  than something a caller has to keep in its head.
- The window line says how the drawing relates to the picture — `drawn 1400x1400 (1.08x of the
  picture)` — because a caller that reads the rendering as the picture itself is wrong by exactly
  that ratio. One session reported reading a "1540x1084 preview" while every number it had was
  in a 2600-pixel space, and concluded the mapping was ambiguous.
- Every view is the same shape: a 1400x1400 square. The picture is placed inside it at the scale
  that fits and whatever is left over is black, so no view can come back as a strip one face

# dsh-locale-ja [English](README.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md) A Japanese language plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI. ## Features - Translates the DSH Web UI into Japanese. - Uses Japanese-friendly fallback fonts while respecting your font settings. - Requests Japanese AI replies when Japanese is explicitly selected. You can still ask for another reply language. ## Compatibility Use this plugin with DSH's Web UI. Choose a compatible tag from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/so16tm/dsh-locale-ja/releases); supported DSH versions and changes are recorded there and in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md). ## Installation Git and GitHub authentication with access to this private repository are required. Replace `` with your selected release tag. Prebuilt files are included; no local build is needed. ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add 'git+https://github.com/so16tm/dsh-locale-ja.git#' dsh web ``` These commands use the `web` profile. Omitting the tag installs `main`, which may contain unreleased changes. To update, run the same `add` command with the new release tag and restart `dsh web`. It replaces the installed version; you do not need to remove it first. To remove: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove @so16tm/dsh-locale-ja ``` Restart DSH after removal. ## Usage Choose **日本語** in **Settings → General → Language**. The reply-language instruction takes effect on the next reply. The instruction requires an explicit Japanese selection saved on the DSH host. It is not added when the language is chosen automatically by the browser or the host cannot save the selection, such as when accessing DSH from another PC on the LAN. Explicit requests for another reply language take precedence. ## Configuration To disable the reply-language instruction, add this entry to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: so16tm-locale-ja config: replyInUiLanguage: false ``` ## Limitations - Remove any other Japanese language plugin before enabling this one. - Newly introduced DSH strings may remain in English until translations are added. ## Development ```sh pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm check ``` `pnpm check` runs type checking, the build, tests, translation coverage, and release-note validation. Follow the [translation guide](docs/translation-guide.md) when editing translations. The [DSH update workflow](.claude/skills/dsh-update/SKILL.md) (Japanese) covers extracting source strings, applying translations, checking compatibility, and releasing. See [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) (Japanese) for design constraints. Commit the generated `lib/` files with source or translation changes. Update both READMEs when usage changes; record release-specific information in CHANGELOG.md. ## License [MIT](LICENSE). Referenced projects are listed in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

plugins.description: Fix the 300s undici bodyTimeout that kills long LLM SSE streams with TypeError: terminated (DeepSeek Harness host plugin)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-stream-timeout-fix

**English** · [简体中文](https://github.com/SundaeYAGO/dsh-stream-timeout-fix/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)

[![CI](https://github.com/SundaeYAGO/dsh-stream-timeout-fix/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/SundaeYAGO/dsh-stream-timeout-fix/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

A tiny **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** host plugin that stops Node's built-in `fetch`
from killing long, silently-stalled LLM streams — the ones that die with

```
TypeError: terminated        (cause: BodyTimeoutError, UND_ERR_BODY_TIMEOUT)
```

after roughly 304–305 seconds of mid-stream silence, and get reported as a
`TRANSPORT` failure even though the provider never hung up.

> **Who this is for.** Third-party / self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoints whose
> responses can take a long time and occasionally stall mid-stream: university or
> company private deployments, LiteLLM-style gateways, self-hosted vLLM, and the
> like. Against a well-behaved large cloud API you probably do not need it.
>
> **Maintenance.** Written by the author for personal use, and published in case it
> helps someone else. It may not be actively maintained, issues and PRs may go
> unanswered, and there is no support commitment. The plugin is ~120 lines — read it
> before you install it. See **Validation status** below for what has (and has not)
> actually been observed.
>
> **Not on npm yet.** `dsh-stream-timeout-fix` has not been published to the npm
> registry, so install it from this repository for now — see [Install](#install).

---

## The symptom

With a streaming LLM endpoint, some requests fail like this:

* the SSE response is **already established and content has started flowing**
  (reasoning tokens, partial answers, tool-call deltas), then
* **nothing arrives for minutes** while the upstream keeps generating, and then
* the request dies locally after ~304–305 s of silence with
  `TypeError: terminated`, classified as a transport/network error.

The provider's own logs show the opposite of a provider-side failure: it records a
**client disconnect** (LiteLLM / nginx log `499`) and the upstream **still finishes
generating and still bills the tokens** — you pay for output you never received.

## The root cause

Node's built-in `fetch` runs on [undici](https://github.com/nodejs/undici), which
ships two client-side clocks that are invisible until they fire:

| Clock | Default | Applies to | Error when it fires |
|---|---|---|---|
| `headersTimeout` | `300_000 ms` | waiting for the first response byte | `TypeError: fetch failed`, cause `HeadersTimeoutError` (`UND_ERR_HEADERS_TIMEOUT`) |
| `bodyTimeout` | `300_000 ms` | idle gap **between body bytes** (re-armed by every received byte) | `TypeError: terminated`, cause `BodyTimeoutError` (`UND_ERR_BODY_TIMEOUT`) |

Because `bodyTimeout` is re-armed per byte, ordinary slow-but-flowing streams are
never affected (streams running 20+ minutes are fine). It only bites when the
**gap** exceeds 300 s — exactly what a stalled upstream produces.

Two things make this hard to attribute correctly:

1. `bodyTimeout` reports itself as **`terminated`**, i.e. literally "the other side
   disconnected". Nothing points at the client's own clock.
2. DSH's failure classifier matches `/terminated/` and maps it to `TRANSPORT`
   (see `dsh-llm-pi-ai`), which reads as a network/provider problem.

So the observable facts (client disconnect in the provider log, `499`, successful
upstream generation, a `TRANSPORT` error on our side) all look like "the platform
drops idle connections at ~300 s" — while the actual killer is our own default.

## What this plugin does

DSH's LLM path never passes a custom `fetch`
(`dsh-llm-pi-ai` → `pi-ai` → OpenAI SDK v6 → `globalThis.fetch` → **global undici
dispatcher**), so one process-wide swap covers every provider at once:

```js
setGlobalDispatcher(new Agent({ bodyTimeout: 1_800_000, headersTimeout: 600_000 }))
```

* `bodyTimeout = 30 min`, `headersTimeout = 10 min` by default — finite on purpose,
  so a genuinely dead peer is still reclaimed.
* Stream-level watchdogs (e.g. pi-ai's `streamIdleTimeoutMs`) and provider retry
  policies remain the real guards; this plugin only removes the *disagreement*
  between two idle clocks.
* Cross-version injection is fine: the global dispatcher lives in a process-wide
  `Symbol.for('undici.globalDispatcher.1')` slot, so an `Agent` created by undici
  8.x is honored by Node's built-in `fetch` (undici 7.x).

## Validation status (read before trusting it)

This plugin was written *after* diagnosing the failure, and it is proven by controlled
local reproduction plus its own test suite — **not** by a real-world stall:

* **Reproduced locally.** A stream that goes silent mid-body is killed by undici's
  default clock at last-byte + ~304 s with `TypeError: terminated`
  (`UND_ERR_BODY_TIMEOUT`); with this plugin's agent the same silence completes
  (`npm test`, `scripts/reproduce-300s.mjs`).
* **Fingerprint match.** Every production failure this was written for showed a
  silence gap of 304.6–305.4 s, `message: "terminated"`, always after content had
  started flowing, never in the headers phase.
* **Field data, 2026-10-13 → 2026-10-18.** Across 19 recorded failures in 11 sessions
  (structural count from `stream finish` events, not log text), the targeted class —
  `TRANSPORT` whose cause chain is `TypeError: terminated` → `BodyTimeoutError`
  (`UND_ERR_BODY_TIMEOUT`) — **did not recur once**. What remains is AUTH / `SERVER 503`
  / `INVALID_REQUEST 404` / `EMPTY_RESPONSE`, plus the wall described in the next bullet.
* **The remaining 300 s wall belongs to DSH, not undici.** On 2026-10-18 two attempts
  were cut at exactly **300.02 s** and **300.04 s** with
  `pi-ai stream idle timeout after 300000ms` (`code: TIMEOUT`) while this plugin's
  undici ceiling was already 30 min — because `streamIdleTimeoutMs` was unset on that
  route and defaults to `300000`. So the silence ceiling is still 300 s until you raise
  it (see “Raise `streamIdleTimeoutMs` as well”). The upside: the error is now the honest
  `TIMEOUT` instead of a misleading `TRANSPORT`.
* **Still not a witnessed survival — and now measured, not guessed.** Two long requests
  completed without ever stalling:
  * **2026-10-18, 314.23 s** (input 438,236 / output 3,791): longest silence **~210 s**,
    below the old ceiling.
  * **2026-10-19, 756.84 s** (input 512,276 / output 17,083, 9,006 per-token
    timestamps): first byte after **91.2 s**, then **max inter-chunk gap 2.6 s** — a
    continuously flowing 12.6-minute generation. Long, but not a stall, so it is *not*
    evidence either.

  A full audit of **9,724 attempts across every session on this machine** finds **zero**
  attempts with an inter-chunk gap ≥ 300 s. The largest silence ever measured is
  **277.0 s** (2026-10-12, *before* the plugin, and it succeeded), while the nine
  pre-fix failures died at **304.6–305.4 s**. Those two numbers bracket undici's 300 s
  default almost exactly — which is the mechanism, demonstrated from both sides.

  So the acceptance test is still open: one silence gap **> 300 s** that completes
  end-to-end. It also needs `streamIdleTimeoutMs` raised (see the section below).
  `scripts/audit-session-gaps.mjs` answers the question in one command:

  ```bash
  node scripts/audit-session-gaps.mjs ~/.dsh/sessions --min-gap-s=250
  # -> lists attempts by largest inter-chunk gap, and how many reached >= 300 s
  ```

If a request still dies during a long silence, compare the gap length: **304–305 s**
points at an undici default clock somewhere in the stack, **exactly 300 s** with
`pi-ai stream idle timeout` points at DSH's own watchdog, and anything else points at a
server/gateway idle limit — which this plugin does not address.

## Install

> **Not on npm yet.** This package has not been published to the npm registry, so
> `npm install dsh-stream-timeout-fix` — and `dsh plugin … add dsh-stream-timeout-fix`
> — will 404 for now. Use the repository recipe immediately below; the npm recipes
> start working after the first publish.

**Requires Node ≥ 22.19** — that is the `undici` dependency's engine requirement
(`engines.node >= 22

plugins.description: Per-session todo lists for DeepSeek Harness: user-defined columns, completion, batch actions, undo and CSV export, plus agent access through a tool.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-todos

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：**每个会话独立的待办清单**，列由用户自定义，默认只有「序号｜事项」。

界面与 AI 共用同一份数据：你在面板上勾选，模型能读到；模型写进去的事项，面板也会显示。

## 特性

- **会话隔离**：每个会话有自己的事项与列配置，互不影响。
- **自定义列**：文本 / 数字 / 日期三种类型，可新增、重命名、左右移动、删除；事项列可改名但不可删除。
- **事项操作**：新增、编辑、删除（带确认）、勾选完成、再次勾选恢复未完成、上移 / 下移。
- **搜索与筛选**：搜索所有列，筛选全部 / 未完成 / 已完成。
- **批量操作**：批量完成、恢复、删除（作用于当前筛选结果）。
- **撤销**：最近 20 次操作可回退，包含删除列及其数据；没有重做。
- **导出 CSV**：导出全量清单（不是当前筛选），带完成标记，兼容中文 Excel，并对公式注入做了转义。
- **按需展示**：不创建就不显示、不占空间；展开后的宽度、内边距、折叠摘要对齐原生任务框。
- **AI 可用**：模型通过 `session_todos` 工具读写同一份清单，与界面共用同一个宿主方法。

## 安装

安装一个 DSH 插件是**两步**，缺一不可：

1. **装依赖** —— 让包在 profile 里可解析；
2. **启用 bundle** —— 把包名写进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

`dsh plugin --profile <name> <args...>` 只是 **pnpm 的转发**（在 profile 目录里执行），所以它只完成第 1 步：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Tpihis/dsh-session-todos.git
cd dsh-session-todos
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"        # ① 装依赖
```

第 2 步没有对应的 CLI 命令，用插件管理器完成：

- GUI：侧边栏「插件」面板里把 `dsh-session-todos` 打开；
- 或让 agent 调 `plugin_manager`：`set_bundle`，`target = dsh-session-todos`，`enabled = true`；
- 或一步到位：`plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，`target` 指向本目录（安装 + 启用）。

**只做第 1 步插件不会加载。** 这不是猜测：`dsh` 只提供 `dsh plugin`（pnpm 转发）和 `--patch` 两个入口，没有 `dsh bundle` 之类的命令；而且本机 profile 里就有一个实例——`@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer` 在 `dependencies` 里但不在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里，因此始终 `enabled: false`。

验证是否启用成功：

```sh
node -e 'console.log(require(process.env.HOME+"/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json").dsh.profile.bundles)'
```

名字出现在这个列表里，并且插件面板显示已启用，才算装好。

安装完成后：

- 宿主半即时生效；
- **客户端半需要刷新一次页面（F5）**才会出现新代码；
- 没有 `pnpm run dev:web` 时，客户端插件不会自动热更新。

## 使用

打开任意会话，输入框上方会出现一行「会话待办」摘要（**未创建清单时不显示**）。点开即可编辑。

也可以直接对模型说：

> 把这些需求加入当前会话待办，并增加分类、优先级和截止日期列。

模型侧的 `todo_write` 是它自己的执行计划，与本清单无关。

## 数据与边界

- 数据存在宿主存储域 `session_custom_todos`（本机位于 `~/.dsh/storages/session_custom_todos/`），**不在插件目录内**，卸载插件不会删除数据。
- 每个会话最多 2000 条事项、20 个数据列；列名最多 80 字符，单元格最多 10000 字符。
- 并发写使用 revision 检查：拿旧版本号提交会被拒绝，提示刷新后重试。
- 会话分支（fork）默认是空白清单，不继承父会话。
- 会话删除后，其域记录不会自动清理。

## 已知限制

- **写操作会在对话里留下一条命令卡片**。界面的写操作通过斜杠命令 `/session-todos` 落到宿主，而 DSH 一定会把命令生命周期（`command/run` + `command/done`）渲染成卡片，无法避免。为让它可读，每次写操作返回一句中文摘要（如「已完成 1 条（2/3 已完成）」），卡片摘要行显示该文本，而不是默认的「已完成」。摘要生成在 `src/model.js` 的 `summarize()`。
- 想做到**完全不产生这类卡片**，需要改用插件自建的 typert RPC（宿主 `ctx.typert.register` + 客户端 `ctx.remote.$mount`）。曾实现过一版，但桥接调用挂起会让面板写入锁卡死，未收敛，故采用当前折中方案。
- 未做第二台机器、其他 DSH 版本、其他操作系统的验证。

## 开发

```
src/host.js        宿主半（apply / inject，命令、工具、会话投影、存储域）
src/model.js       纯业务逻辑（校验、变更、撤销、视图、摘要）+ 单元测试
src/model.test.js  测试：node --test src/model.test.js
client.js          浏览器半（React，通过 __ModuleLoader__ 注册）
cordis.patch.yml   bundle 补丁，插入一行 session-todos
```

### 改完代码为什么不生效

运行中的 DSH 进程按 URL 缓存已导入的模块，而 profile 安装的 bundle **不会**因为自身文件变化而热重载。原地改文件，跑的还是旧模块。

```sh
npm run refresh     # 给入口的相对导入写入内容哈希 ./model.js?v=<hash>
```

然后重新启用 bundle（或重启 DSH）。哈希必须是**字面量**——Loader 要静态读取入口的 `export const inject`，所以不能用 `Date.now()` / `Math.random()` 在运行时拼。

注意：`refresh` 只能让入口**的依赖**换 URL；如果入口文件本身（`src/host.js`）的缓存需要失效，仍然要重启 DSH 或更换入口文件名。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH web_fetch fallback: when AnySearch extraction fails with HTTP 422, the page is fetched directly with a browser-like user agent. Zero-dependency DSH plugin.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-anysearch-fallback

**给 DSH 的 `web_fetch` 加一条降级兜底：AnySearch 抽不出内容（HTTP 422）时，自动改用浏览器 UA 直抓。**
*Gives DSH's `web_fetch` a fallback: when AnySearch cannot extract a page (HTTP 422), fetch it directly with a browser-like user agent instead of failing the whole call.*

[中文](#中文) · [English](#english)

---

## 中文

### 它解决什么问题

DSH 的 `web_fetch` 走 AnySearch 的 `/v1/extract`。有些页面（`openai.com`、知乎问题页、不存在的路径……）上游会返回 **HTTP 422 `extract_failed`**，于是整次 `web_fetch` 直接报错。本插件在那个位置接一手：先照旧走 AnySearch，**上游一失败就直抓原文兜底**（唯一例外是"取消"），并在正文首行写明上游失败的真实原因。

### 工作机制

```
ctx.web 注册的 provider 链：
  anysearch-fallback (provider id: anysearch-fallback)   ← web_fetch 选中它
        │
        ├─ 代理到官方 AnySearch provider 的 extract
        │     ├─ 成功 → 原样返回（逐字段不变）
        │     ├─ 任何失败（422 / 401 / 402 / 403 / 429 / 超时 / 网络…）→ 进入直抓兜底
        │     │     兜底结果的正文首行写明上游失败原因（状态 + 摘要）
        │     └─ 取消 / abort → 原样抛错，绝不降级（调用方已要求停止）
        │
        └─ 直抓兜底：浏览器 UA + 协议/内网校验 + 5 MB 字节上限 + 15s 超时
              → 返回带标记的纯文本（正文顶部写入降级标记，模型一眼可辨）
```

- 本插件**不修改**官方 `@anysearch/anysearch-dsh` 的任何文件，也不改 DSH 私有字段；它以自己的 id `anysearch-fallback` 注册 provider，内部再按 id 调官方 `anysearch` provider。
- 官方插件升级/重装对本插件**无影响**（若官方改了 provider id，需要同步改 `index.mjs` 里的 `UPSTREAM_PROVIDER_ID`）。
- 兜底失败时，抛出的错误里同时带上「上游原始错误」与「直抓失败原因」+ 一句可行动提示，两侧信息都不吞。

### 关键行为

| 项目 | 取值 |
| --- | --- |
| provider id | `anysearch-fallback`（由本插件的 `- id: web` 覆盖把 `fetchProvider` 指到它；上游仍是官方 `anysearch`） |
| 触发降级 | **任何上游错误**：422 / 401（凭据）/ 402（额度）/ 403 / 429（限流）/ 5xx / 超时 / 网络错误 / 非 JSON 响应，无一例外 |
| 不降级（唯一例外） | **取消 / abort**：调用方的 `signal` 已中止，或错误链上有 `name: AbortError`、`code: ABORT_ERR / WEB_ABORTED / extract_canceled`、消息含 `abort`/`cancel` → 原样抛，不直抓 |
| 协议白名单 | 仅 `http:` / `https:`（`file:` / `data:` / `ftp:` / `blob:` 等拒绝） |
| 内网拒绝 | `localhost` / `*.localhost` / `*.local` / `.internal`；IPv4 `0.0.0.0`、`127/8`、`10/8`、`172.16/12`、`192.168/16`、`169.254/16`、`100.64/10`；IPv6 `::1`、`fc00::/7`、`fe80::/10`；IPv4-mapped IPv6（`::ffff:127.0.0.1`） |
| 字节上限 | 5 MB，流式读取（`response.body`），超限立即 `cancel()` |
| 字符上限 | 与 DSH 工具侧一致（`DEFAULT_FETCH_MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS`），超出裁剪并置 `truncated: true` |
| 超时 | 自带 15s，串联上游 `signal`，任一触发即中止并说明来源 |
| 请求头 | 固定桌面 Chrome UA + `accept` + `accept-language`；**不带** Authorization / Cookie / Referer |
| 重定向 | `redirect: 'manual'`，最多 3 跳，**每一跳都重做协议与内网校验** |
| 磁盘缓存 | 无 |

### 降级标记（永远在返回正文的第一行）

标记会写明**上游失败的真实原因**（状态 + 截断到 240 字符的摘要）和**直抓实际拿到的状态**；正文为空时说清"没有正文"，免得"只有一行标记"被读成"这页面是空的"。

| 情形 | 第一行 |
| --- | --- |
| 上游 422，直抓 2xx 有正文 | `[anysearch-fallback] 上游抽取失败（HTTP 422）：AnySearch extract failed: … (HTTP 422, auth credential)；直抓成功（HTTP 200），以下为未经 AnySearch 清洗的直抓原文。` |
| 上游 429，直抓 2xx 有正文 | `[anysearch-fallback] 上游错误（HTTP 429 rate limit）：AnySearch extract failed: "too many requests"；直抓成功（HTTP 200），以下为未经 AnySearch 清洗的直抓原文。` |
| 直抓非 2xx，有正文 | `[anysearch-fallback] 上游错误（HTTP 429 rate limit）：…；直抓返回 HTTP 403（站点可能拒绝匿名访问），以下为站点返回的原始内容，未经 AnySearch 清洗。` |
| 直抓非 2xx，正文为空 | `[anysearch-fallback] 上游错误（HTTP 429 rate limit）：…；直抓返回 HTTP 403 且站点未返回任何正文内容（该页可能需要登录或被反爬拦截，建议换来源）。` |
| 直抓 2xx，正文为空 | `[anysearch-fallback] 上游错误（HTTP 500）：…；直抓成功（HTTP 200）但站点未返回任何正文内容（可能是空页或正文由脚本渲染，建议换来源）。` |

- 状态取上游错误里真实的 `httpStatus`；命中"抽取失败"那三种精确形状（`httpStatus === 422` / `errorCode` 字段值 `extract_failed` / 那句 `Unable to extract content from the URL.`）时措辞为**上游抽取失败**，否则为**上游错误**（并在拿得到时附上 `rate limit` / `auth credential` 这类标签）。
- 摘要**压平空白并截断**到 240 字符（`MAX_MARKER_UPSTREAM_CHARS`），标记行因此永远是一眼能读完的一行，不是日志。
- 每次降级还会记一条 `warn` 日志（含上游原因与直抓结果）。

### 安装

作为本地插件挂进某个 DSH profile：

```bash
# 1) 把本目录放到 <DSH_HOME>/plugins/dsh-anysearch-fallback/
# 2) 在 profile 的 package.json 里加依赖（相对路径写法）
#    "dsh-anysearch-fallback": "file:C:/Users/you/.dsh/plugins/dsh-anysearch-fallback"
# 3) 把它追加到 profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles 末尾
#    （放最后 = 它的 `- id: web` 覆盖在官方 anysearch 之后生效）
# 4) 在 profile 的 node_modules 下建同名入口（本机既有形状：真目录 + 硬链接）
# 5) 重启 DSH —— 新开一个对话不够，profile 的配置树是启动时组合的
```

本插件的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会 `insert` 自己的 bundle（id `dsh-anysearch-fallback`），并把 web 服务的 `fetchProvider` 覆盖为 `anysearch-fallback`（`searchProvider` 必须一起原样写上——patch 对 `config` 是整体替换、不深合并）。具体层内覆盖请按你的 profile 现状调整。

### 测试

```bash
npm test            # 离线单测：63 通过 / 1 跳过（联网用例默认跳过）
```

`test/integration.test.mjs` 是**联网实测**用例（真实 422 → 真实直抓）：它需要 `@anysearch/anysearch-dsh` 及其 peer 包可被解析。仓库内默认跳过；在本机已装好的环境里可按该文件头部的注释搭一个临时 staging 目录（`node_modules` 里为 `@deepseek-ai/*` 建 junction）后运行。

### 已知边界 / 未做

- **DNS rebinding 只防一半**：除字面 IP / 主机名判定外，会在 DNS 解析后再核一遍解析到的 IP（任一解析结果非公网即拒）；但**没有地址钉扎** —— 校验用的解析结果与真正建连之间有时间差（TOCTOU），极端的 rebinding 仍可能穿过。
  *(对比：`dsh-web` 自带的 `dsh-web-fetch-http` 用 `ipaddr.js` + undici pinned agent 做了完整钉扎；本插件刻意零依赖，故未复刻。)*
- **带 userinfo 的 URL 会被拒绝**：`http://user:pw@example.com/`（只给用户名也算）一律以 `WEB_BLOCKED_URL` 拒掉，错误消息里点名 userinfo；**不做静默剥离** —— 用户显式给了带凭证的 URL 就明确报错，比悄悄改写更可预测。
- **保守拒绝**：`168.63/16`、`198.18/15`、`192.0.0/24` 等非公网段被判为内网并拒绝，宁可误拒。
- **提取质量**：朴素 HTML 降噪（去 script/style、取标题、解实体、折叠空白），质量低于 AnySearch 的正文清洗；结果顶部有降级标记，便于人工/模型识别。
- **系统性问题现在也会降级（这是宽兜底的代价）**：上游 401（凭据失效）、402（额度耗尽）、429（限流）这类问题**不再整次报错**，而是静默降级为直抓结果 —— 直抓往往仍能成功，于是"接口已经不可用了，但抓取照常返回"。要判断集成是否正常，看**正文首行的标记**（里面写明上游错误，例如 `上游错误（HTTP 429 rate limit）：…`）与日志里的 `warn` 行。
- **不做重试**：无论上游还是直抓都不重试。
- **不改超时预算**：`web_fetch` 工具预算 30 s 由 DSH 工具层硬编码，本插件不碰；兜底直抓自带 15 s，若上游已耗尽大部分预算，兜底可能来不及完成。
- **非 2xx 不假装成功**：直抓拿到 4xx/5xx 时按真实状态码返回（并保留正文）。
- **反爬限制**：目标站可能对匿名直抓返回 403 或直接给反爬页（例：`openai.com` 返回 403 且正文为空；知乎问题页返回 403 + 一句反爬文案）。此时降级正文可能为空或根本不是真正文 —— 标记行会把这种情况说清楚（含"站点未返回任何正文内容"），但拿不到内容就是拿不到，建议换来源。
- **改完必须重启 DSH**：已启动的 DSH 进程加载的是启动时的代码；升级或改动本插件（包括只改了降级标记文案）后，**必须重启 DSH**（新开一个对话不够）新代码才生效。

### License

MIT

---

## English

**Problem.** `web_fetch` goes through AnySearch `/v1/extract`; for some pages the upstream answers **HTTP 422 `extract_failed`** and the whole fetch call fails. This plugin registers its own `anysearch-fallback` fetch provider, points the web service at it, delegates to the official `anysearch` provider first, and degrades to a guarded direct fetch on **any** upstream failure — the only exception is cancellation.

**Guarantees.**

- Success path unchanged, field for field.
- Cancellation (`signal` aborted, `AbortError`, `ABORT_ERR` / `WEB_ABORTED` / `extract_canceled`, abort/cancel wording) is never degraded: the original error surfaces untouched and no new request is sent.
- Any other upstream failure (401/402/403/429/timeouts/network) degrades, and the reason is written into the first line of the returned body plus a `warn` log line — never silently swallowed.
- Only `http:`/`https:`; localhost, private, link-local, CGNAT and IPv4-mapped IPv6 targets are refused.
- A URL carrying userinfo (`user:pw@host`) is refused as `WEB_BLOCKED_URL` and named as such — never silently stripped.
- Hard 5 MB byte cap read as a stream (`response.body`), never `response.text()`; character cap matches DSH's tool layer.
- 15 s own timeout chained to the upstream abort signal.
- Fixed desktop Chrome UA plus `accept`/`accept-language`; no Authorization, Cookie, Referer; no TLS bypass; no disk cache.
- Manual redirects, at most 3 hops, re-validated at every hop.
- Fallback output carries a visible marker line naming both real statuses, so a degraded result is never mistaken for cleaned text and an empty body is never mistaken for an empty page.

**Not done.** No address pinning after resolution (one re-check, then a separate connect — TOCTOU remains), no retry, no timeout-budget change, naive HTML reduction (lower quality than AnySearch extraction). Anti-bot sites may answer 403 with an empty body or a challenge page: the marker says so, but there is no content to return — change the source instead.

**Cost of the broad fallback.** Systemic upstream problems (401 credentials, 402 quota, 429 rate limit) now degrade instead of failing the call, so a broken integration can still return pages. Watch the marker line (it names the upstream error) and the `warn` log line.

**Restart required.** A running DSH process keeps the code it booted with; restart DSH after changing this plugin (a new chat is not enough).

**Test.** `npm test` — 63 passed / 1 skipped offline. The network integration test is skipped unless the installed official bundle and its peer packages are resolvable.

*

plugins.description: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness ⇄ JetBrains integration: DSH chat inside your IDE, and your IDE workspace — project, attached modules, active file and caret — in front of the model.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH ⇄ JetBrains

Small packages that connect a local [DeepSeek Harness](../../) (DSH) to a JetBrains IDE, so the IDE and
the agent share one workspace instead of two islands.

Each one works on its own: the IDE plugin and the DSH bundle are the two halves of the same workflow, and
the session-link plugin only lets a page be asked for a session by address. The DSH bundle carries both a
Host half and a web-client half, so installing it covers the tool, the context line, and the clicks.

| Package | Platform | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`jetbrains-companion/`](jetbrains-companion) | IntelliJ Platform plugin (Java, no Gradle) | **DSH Chat** tool window embedding DSH's own web client, one DSH session per IDE window, live workspace publication, a loopback bridge so DSH can put a file in front of you, and a `DSH Changes` tool window that shows a published turn as a native side-by-side IntelliJ diff. |
| [`jetbrains-workspace/`](jetbrains-workspace) | DSH profile bundle (host half + web-client half, plain JavaScript) | Reads the IDE's workspace — including a module's multiple content roots from its `.iml` — into DSH as a tool, a runtime context line, and a registered workspace. Works with the companion running or from the IDE's own state files after it closed. Sends opened and clicked files to the IDE: the Host half replaces DSH's default desktop opener, and the client half redirects the Sidebar file viewer. |
| [`jetbrains-session-link/`](jetbrains-session-link) | DSH client plugin (plain JavaScript) | Lets `#dsh-session=<id>` — or a hash change on an open page — select that session without a reload. Optional: the chat panel falls back to the client's stored selection when it is absent. |

> **Unofficial.** Neither package is made by, endorsed by, or affiliated with JetBrains or DeepSeek.
> IntelliJ, IDEA and JetBrains are trademarks of JetBrains s.r.o.

## What you get

- **Chat inside the IDE.** The `DSH Chat` tool window renders DSH's web client, authenticated with the
  same browser-session cookie DSH gives a browser, and opens the session for the window you are in.
- **One workspace, seen from both sides.** The window's root project and every attached module/VCS
  directory reach the model as a runtime context line and as a `jetbrains_workspace` tool result, with
  each directory labelled by the source that reported it.
- **Round trip.** DSH can read the active file, caret and selection, and open a file in the IDE at a
  line — with the companion's bridge, or with the IDE state files when the IDE is closed.

- **Review a turn as a diff.** `DSH Changes` lists every turn `dsh-jetbrains-workspace` publishes and
  opens any changed file as a native side-by-side IntelliJ diff. A turn's diff also opens by itself, with a
  **Keep** / **Revert** notification, the chat panel's toolbar has a **Changes** toggle, and reverting works
  per file or per hunk — refusing rather than half-reverting a file that changed since the turn.
- **Nothing is lost while the IDE is closed.** The review document outlives the IDE: on the next start the
  companion mentions the turns it missed, with one click to the panel.

## Why one DSH, not one per project

Because the value is in seeing everything at once. One Host process holds every session, so a reader can keep
an agent running in one project under watch while working on something else in another session that has
nothing to do with the IDE. It is also why this bundle publishes one review document for the whole Host
rather than one per workspace: the changes panel lists the turns of every session that changed files, so an
agent left running in another project still reports where the reader already is.

The IDE side leans the same way. One companion serves the whole IDE: the chat panel keeps one session per
project, the window junction can be told to register the shared parent so a multi-module checkout is one
workspace (`junctionRoot: common-parent`), and `jetbrains_workspace` answers for every attached directory.

What that costs, measured rather than assumed: the companion descriptor is *one file per user*, and the
companion starts **one bridge per IDE run**. Opening a second IDE window produced no second `bridge on` line,
and the one descriptor already named both windows' projects. So a Host reaches every window through one
bridge, DSH's workspace tool sees all of them, and the companion decides which window shows a diff or opens a
file by matching the path against each project's base path. The Host also accepts a *set* of descriptors (the
single one plus any `jetbrains-companion/*.json` beside it) and chooses by workspace, so a future build that
publishes one descriptor per window needs no Host change.

## What each half gives you

Each half is useful alone, and they do not depend on each other to install. What you get changes:

| Capability | IDE plugin only | DSH bundle only | Both |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DSH Chat` tool window in the IDE (embedded DSH client, cookie auth) | yes | — | yes |
| One DSH session per IDE window, grouped in the DSH sidebar | yes — the panel registers the workspace and creates or attaches the session itself | — | yes |
| The model knows which IDE window is open (runtime context line) | — | yes, from the IDE's state files, or live when the companion runs | yes |
| `jetbrains_workspace` tool: root project, module content roots, active file, caret, selection | — | yes | yes |
| `jetbrains_open_in_ide`: the model opens a file in the IDE | — | no — it needs the companion's bridge | yes |
| Session selected without reloading the page | no — it seeds the client's stored selection and reloads once | — | yes, with `jetbrains-session-link` |
| Change review of a turn (which files, and their diffs) | — | yes — publishes `<DSH home>/jetbrains-changes.json` with the coordinates DSH's own `/api/changes.*` routes need | yes |
| A presented artifact opens in the IDE (`present` → editor tab) | — | opt-in — `autoOpenDeliverables: true`, and only for the window's own session | yes (needs the companion bridge) |
| A turn's changes as a native side-by-side IntelliJ diff | yes — the `DSH Changes` tool window | yes — publishes the document it reads | yes |
| A turn's diff opens by itself, with Keep / Revert | yes — `POST /changed` on the companion bridge | yes — posts the notice (`autoOpenDiffs`) | yes |
| Revert a file, or one hunk of it | yes — the panel and the notification action | — | yes |
| Turns published while the IDE was closed | yes — mentioned on the next start | yes — the document outlives the IDE | yes |
| Clicking a deliverable or changed file opens it in the IDE | — | the wrap is on by default (`openInIde`), but the IDE itself needs the companion's bridge — without one the desktop opener still runs | yes |
| Clicking a file in the DSH UI opens it in the IDE, not the DSH sidebar viewer | — | yes, on by default (`openSidebarFilesInIde`) — falls back to the sidebar | yes (needs the companion bridge) |

So: install the **IDE plugin** to chat with DSH inside your IDE (it needs a DSH running locally, and
reads DSH's credential document to sign the browser cookie — see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)). Install
the **DSH bundle** to put your IDE workspace in front of the model. Install **both** for the round
trip, where the model can name the file you are editing and open another one for you.

The two halves talk through DSH's own HTTP API and the companion's descriptor
(`<DSH home>/jetbrains-companion.json`, carrying a `version` and a `source` marker), so either half can
be updated on its own: a bundle that finds no live descriptor falls back to the IDE's state files, and a
companion never requires the bundle to be installed.

## Install

```sh
git clone https://github.com/abadiegie/dsh-jetbrains.git
```

```sh
cd jetbrains-companion
./build.sh                 # compiles against the installed IDE and copies the jar into it
IDE_HOME=/path/to/idea ./build.sh
```

Then restart the IDE. Settings live under `Settings ▸ Tools ▸ DSH Companion`. Step 1 needs no DSH-side
plugin; installing it alone gives you the chat panel (se

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin publish armor: pre-publish leak scan + entry-safe obfuscation
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-publish-guard

DeepSeek Harness 插件**发布前**硬化工具链，两个命令：

| 命令 | 干什么 | 定位 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh-leak-check` | 发布前泄漏检查（只读，不执行任何脚本） | **A：抓自己的漏洞** |
| `dsh-obfuscate` | 入口安全的混淆（防"顺手党"逆向） | **B：抬高别人读实现的成本** |

## 为什么是这两个

DSH 插件是 JavaScript，走 npm 分发 —— **任何用户都能把包下载下来看**。所以：

- 真危险的不是"别人能看"，而是**你自己把不该发的东西发了出去**（source map、密钥、.env、测试文件）→ A
- 真能做的防逆向不是"阻止"，而是**把成本从分钟级抬到小时级**（挡顺手党，不挡决心党）→ B

## dsh-leak-check

```
dsh-leak-check bundle <file> [--json]        扫一个构建产物
dsh-leak-check pack <dir> [--json]           扫包目录（files 白名单 + 磁盘）
dsh-leak-check preflight <dir> [--bundle f]  一键
```

分级：**violation**（会送掉源码/密钥的硬伤）· **review**（疑似，人工看）· **note**（提醒）。
铁律：`宁 review，不 violation` —— 密钥类一律 review，绝不公开指控。

检查项：source map、9 类疑似密钥、高熵长串、调试残留、test/.env/.pem/.map 混进包、
溯源指纹（正面加分）。**不运行 npm、不执行被检查包的任何脚本**（`npm pack` 会跑
prepack/prepare，对不受信任的包是危险的）。

## dsh-obfuscate

```
dsh-obfuscate <in.js> <out.js> [--preset lite|medium|max] [--no-protect-entry]
```

- **入口保护**：在 `__ModuleLoader__` 标记前最近语句边界切分，挂载段逐字明文、只混淆载荷；
  切分失败自动退回整文件（此时入口文本可能被 stringArray 编码，功能由冒烟保证）
- **自动冒烟**：混淆后模拟 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 加载产物，入口坏了就失败
- 强制无 sourceMap；输入含 sourceMappingURL → 拒绝（除非 `--allow-map`）
- 拒绝原地覆盖；`selfDefending` 默认关（它等于给用户机器装地雷）
- 输出带溯源指纹：`built-from-src-sha256:xxxx obfuscated:lite|medium|max`

**诚实提醒（工具输出里永远带着）**：混淆只挡顺手党；别把密钥放进客户端；
发布前建议再跑一遍 `dsh-leak-check`。

## 测试

```
node --test        # 18 项：A 12 项 + B 6 项
```

## 用在哪

- `dsh-leak-check` 适合任何插件作者的 CI / prePublish
- `dsh-obfuscate` 适合"确实有闭源需求"的插件；**不建议用在以信任为卖点的插件上**
  （用户看不见它在干什么 = 信任崩塌）

## 与其它工具的关系

| 工具 | 关系 |
|---|---|
| `dsh-contract-check` | 检查**契约**（render/事件/打包白名单）；本工具检查**泄漏**，互补 |
| `dsh-surface-check` | 扫描指令文件投毒（运行时）；本工具是发布前的静态检查 |

plugins.description: DSH plugin that lets the model drive the right-Sidebar browser: read pages, click, type, navigate, switch phone/tablet/desktop viewport sizes, and screenshot. Desktop only; never touches app.asar.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-browser

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Let the model actually **use** the DSH right-Sidebar browser: read a page's text,
click and type in it, navigate, size the viewport, and take screenshots — from
ordinary tool calls in the conversation.

It also adds a **phone / tablet / desktop / custom viewport switcher**, so you can
see how a site renders at another size without leaving the app.

```
browser_navigate { url: "https://example.com" }
browser_read     { mode: "elements" }     -> refs e1, e2, …
browser_act      { action: "type", ref: "e1", text: "hello" }
browser_act      { action: "click", ref: "e2" }
browser_screenshot {}                     -> see the layout
browser_viewport { preset: "phone" }      -> re-render at 390×844
```

> **Desktop only.** The tools drive an Electron `<webview>` guest. In Web
> profiles the Sidebar browser is a sandboxed cross-origin `<iframe>`, whose DOM
> cannot be read at all, so the tools answer with an explicit reason naming the
> Web profile instead of pretending to work. `browser_tabs` still lists those
> tabs — as `mounted: true` with `carrier: "iframe"` — so you can see that the
> tab exists and why it cannot be driven.

> **Third-party, non-invasive plugin.** It mounts from your DSH profile, never
> touches `app.asar`, and leaves the built-in browser exactly as shipped.

- [Install](#install) — one command, or the Plugins page
- [Tools](#tools) — what the model can call
- [Which size to use](#which-size-to-use) — pick desktop or phone, not the default
- [Viewport sizes](#viewport-sizes-phone--desktop--custom) — the UI side
- [Compatibility](#compatibility) — verified against DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`
- [Known limitations](#known-limitations) — read before filing an issue

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `browser_tabs` | List this Session's browser tabs: id, title, url, loading state, **whether the load failed** (`failed`), whether the identity was inferred (`unverified`), whether each is mounted and drivable, which is `active`, and its `carrier` (`webview` on Desktop, `iframe` on Web). |
| `browser_read` | Read a tab: `mode: 'text'` (default) for visible text, `'elements'` for the interactive elements you can act on, `'html'` for page HTML. Check `failed` first — a failed load reads as empty. `truncated` means the element cap was reached — hidden elements are filtered out silently and never counted as truncation. |
| `browser_act` | `click`, `type`, `press`, `scroll`, `select`, `reload`, or `wait`. Target an element by the `ref` from a `'elements'` read, or by a CSS `selector`. `reload` takes `ignoreCache: true` to bypass the cache. `wait` with a `selector` becomes a real wait — see *Waiting for the page* below. |
| `browser_screenshot` | Capture the visible viewport as an image block the model can see. Pass a `preset` to size and capture in one call; the result reports the size it actually used and whether the page was confirmed to have reflowed (`confirmed`). A failed page is refused rather than captured. |
| `browser_navigate` | Open a URL in a new tab, or navigate an existing one. |
| `browser_viewport` | Read or change the tab's viewport size: `auto`, `phone` (390×844), `tablet` (834×1112), `desktop` (1280×800) or `custom`. The page reflows for real, so its own responsive breakpoints apply. Omit `tabId` to target the only mounted tab; the read always reports the tab it resolved. `custom` appears only for the `custom` preset. |
| `browser_close` | Close one tab of this Session, so tabs opened while investigating something can be cleaned up. Closure is confirmed before the call reports success. |
| `browser_eval` | Run JavaScript in the page — the only way to read layout geometry (`getBoundingClientRect`, `scrollHeight`, `getComputedStyle`). **Always listed; refuses until `enableEval: true`** (see configuration), so the capability is discoverable instead of unguessable. An expression returns its value; a statement body returns what it explicitly `return`s. |

A typical loop:

```
browser_navigate { url: "https://example.com" }
browser_read     { mode: "elements" }          -> refs e1, e2, …
browser_act      { action: "type", ref: "e1", text: "hello" }
browser_act      { action: "click", ref: "e2" }
browser_read     { mode: "text" }              -> confirm what changed
browser_screenshot { preset: "desktop" }       -> see the real desktop layout
browser_screenshot { preset: "phone" }         -> and the 390px-wide one
browser_close    { tabId: "tab4" }             -> tidy up when finished
```

`tabId` may be omitted whenever the Session has exactly one mounted browser tab.
With several, call `browser_tabs` first and name the one you mean.

### Reading a failed page

Three fields describe three different things, and none of them can be inferred
from the others:

| Field | Means |
|---|---|
| `mounted` | The tab is in the DOM and could be driven — **not** that it loaded. |
| `loading` | Electron says a navigation is in flight. A *failed* load is not loading. |
| `failed` | The tab is on Chrome's network-error page, so there is no site content. |

So `mounted: true, loading: false, failed: true` is a completely ordinary
combination: a tab that is open and finished failing. Before `failed` existed, a
page that never loaded looked identical to a healthy one, and the only way to
tell was to read it and notice the text was empty.

`unverified: true` is the other half: the page could not be asked anything (its
renderer is wedged, or the document is unreachable), so `url` and `title` are the
last navigation's, not the current document's. Treat them as a hint, not a fact.

Both matter for screenshots, which is where the confusion cost the most: a
capture is **refused** when either is set. A failed load paints Chrome's error
page, and a wedged renderer paints a blank surface — either way the image is not
the site, and returning it as a successful capture is how a page that never
loaded gets mistaken for a page that "did not render". Note that `failed` cannot
even be evaluated when the page is unscriptable, so `unverified` is doing real
work rather than restating it.

So `unverified` is deliberately *not* just a warning label: it is the condition
that makes a capture unverifiable. Inside a capture the identity probe is given
more patience than elsewhere (up to 4 s) precisely so a genuinely heavy page —
the several-iframes case a 15 s budget exists for — is not refused merely for
being briefly busy.

Note that this is about *transport* failures only. An HTTP error the site itself
rendered — a 404 page — is a real document and stays fully readable and
screenshotable.

## Waiting for the page

`browser_act { action: "wait" }` has two forms, and the difference matters on any
page a framework renders.

**A fixed sleep** — `{ action: "wait", timeoutMs: 2500 }` — sleeps and returns.
Rarely what you want, for a reason worth stating: the plugin's own notion of "the
page has loaded" is Electron's **navigation** state, which a single-page app
clears as soon as its HTML and scripts arrive, long before React (or anything
else) has mounted and painted. So the page reports itself loaded while the screen
is still empty, and a sleep is a guess that is too short on a slow machine and
wasted on a fast one. A report measured exactly that: a 2500 ms guess in a loop
that ran ten times.

**A named condition** waits for something observable instead:

```
browser_act { action: "wait", selector: ".todo-list", state: "visible" }
```

- `state: "visible"` (the default) — the element is **drawn**. This is what "the
  app has rendered" usually means.
- `state: "attached"` — the element merely **exists**. Weaker, and worth knowing
  about: an element can exist while `display: none`. A report counted hidden rows
  as present and concluded a layout had no overflow, so the two are kept distinct.
- `state: "hidden"` — satisfied by **absent as well as invisible**, so it works for
  waiting out a spinner that gets removed rather than hidden.

Omit `timeoutMs` and the wait uses the rest of the call's own budget (still
bounded, never longer than the call).

The condition is polled **inside the page**, so one tool call watches for

plugins.description: DSH 备份 / 换机同步插件：把技能、插件、配置、记忆、待办打成一个包，换机时按模块做带基线的三方合并导入
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-backup-sync

> 给 **DeepSeek Harness** 的**备份 / 恢复 / 换机同步**插件：
> 把技能、插件、配置、记忆、待办打成一个 `tar.gz`，换台电脑**按模块增量导入**，
> 靠一份基线库做三方合并 —— 不覆盖你在这台机器上新改的东西。
> 也能直接把包推到**你自己的 WebDAV 空间**（绿联 / 群晖 / 坚果云 / Nextcloud…），换机时下载回来。

[![CI](https://github.com/Arlenman/dsh-backup-sync/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Arlenman/dsh-backup-sync/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-brightgreen.svg)](package.json)

---

## 目录

- [它解决什么问题](#它解决什么问题)
- [和 dsh-backup 有什么不同](#和-dsh-backup-有什么不同)
- [安装](#安装)
- [界面](#界面)
- [六个模块](#六个模块)
- [文件放在哪](#文件放在哪)
- [增量导入：基线三方合并](#增量导入基线三方合并)
- [两条红线](#两条红线)
- [定时备份](#定时备份)
- [云端备份（WebDAV）](#云端备份webdav)
- [HTTP 接口](#http-接口)
- [开发](#开发)
- [已知限制](#已知限制)
- [English](#english)
- [License](#license)

---

## 它解决什么问题

DSH 的「资产」散落在**两个地方**：

| 资产 | 位置 |
| --- | --- |
| 技能（工作流本体） | `<userHome>/.agents/skills` |
| 插件清单 / 依赖锁 | `<dshHome>/profiles/<profile>/` |
| 核心配置（provider、模型、主题、插件配置） | `<dshHome>/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` |
| 记忆 / 待办 | `<dshHome>/memories/` |
| 对话记录 | `<dshHome>/sessions/` |

其中 `<dshHome>` 默认是 `~/.dsh`，而**技能根本不在它下面**。
换电脑时最容易丢的恰好是技能和配置 —— 而它们又最值钱。

这个插件把上面这些一起打包，并且解决第二个问题：**导入时不要把人家的新东西冲掉**。

## 和 dsh-backup 有什么不同

[`@xiaoyuyu6420/dsh-backup`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xiaoyuyu6420/dsh-backup) 是一个成熟的全量备份插件（本插件作者也在用），但它的 `skills` 类型找的是 `~/.dsh/skills`；技能库实际住在 `~/.agents/skills`（`~/.dsh` 之外），所以在技能装在标准位置的机器上，**它备不到技能**。

两者的定位：

| | dsh-backup | dsh-backup-sync（本插件） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 备份范围 | `~/.dsh` 整棵树（可按类型排除） | 六个模块，**含 `~/.agents/skills`** |
| 导入语义 | 恢复（覆盖） | **带基线的三方合并**，逐文件给差异 |
| 冲突处理 | — | 弹差异预览，逐文件选保留哪边 |
| 云同步 | 内置 GitHub 私有仓库同步 | 推送到「同步目录」（可指向任何被同步工具盯着的目录） |
| 救援 | 有进程外救援脚本 | — |

**两个可以同时装**，互不干扰（备份目录、状态文件都不同名）。

## 安装

```bash
# 从 npm 装（0.2.0，不需要连 GitHub）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-backup-sync

# 从 GitHub 装（推荐锁 tag，可复现）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Arlenman/dsh-backup-sync#v0.2.0

# 跟 main 分支走
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Arlenman/dsh-backup-sync

# 或直接用发行版里的 tar.gz
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Arlenman/dsh-backup-sync/releases/download/v0.2.0/dsh-backup-sync-0.2.0.tgz
```

桌面版（Electron）在 **设置 → 插件** 里粘贴上面任意一条即可。

**换台电脑（家里另一台）就填这一条**：

```
github:Arlenman/dsh-backup-sync#v0.2.0
```

这条路已经实测过（2026-10-15，拿 `github:Arlenman/dsh-backup-sync#v0.1.0` 对**真仓库**跑 `pnpm add`，
51.5 秒装完）：pnpm 拉的是 codeload 从仓库树打的 tarball（锁文件里记的是 `gitHosted: true` +
sha512 integrity），当时装出来 **22 个文件**（`lib/*.js` 18 个 + `package.json` + `cordis.patch.yml`
+ `README.md` + `LICENSE`），与 Release 里那个 `.tgz` **逐个文件、逐字节一致**（22/22，sha256 全等）；
解析到的提交是 `289819f`（= 当时的 tag `v0.1.0`），装出来的 `lib/index.js` 用 node 直接 import 就能加载。
`v0.2.0` 的包是 **25 个文件**（`lib/*.js` 21 个 + `package.json` + `cordis.patch.yml` + `README.md` + `LICENSE`，
打包后 **130,583 字节**），**安装路径一字未变**。
仓库里**没有 `prepare` / `prepublish` / `postinstall` 脚本、没有 `dependencies`**，
`lib/` 是提交进仓库的现成 JS ⇒ **目标机器不需要构建，也不需要装任何依赖**。

两个前提：

- 目标机器要能连上 `github.com`。插件管理器在装 git 依赖前有 **5 秒** github.com 预检，
  之后 pnpm 拉 `codeload.github.com` 的 tarball（**60 秒** idle 超时）。包本体约 130 KB，慢网也够。
- 装完**重启一次 DSH**（宿主半边不热重载，见下）。

> npm 上的是 `0.2.0`（2026-10-18 发布），registry 里那份包就是本仓库 `v0.2.0` 打出来的：
> 25 个文件、130,583 字节，本地 `sha256` 与 registry 上重新下载的 tarball 逐字节一致（已匿名复核）。
> 目标机器连不上 `github.com`、或不想为装插件开代理时用 npm 装法；要锁到某个具体提交时用 GitHub 装法。

> **注意**：插件的宿主半边（HTTP 路由）**不热重载**，装完要重启一次 DSH；
> 界面半边刷新页面即可生效。

要求：DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`，Node.js ≥ 22。零 npm 运行时依赖（只用 Node 内置模块 + 平台提供的 `react`；打包那一步调用系统自带的 `tar`）。

## 界面

入口在 **设置 → 备份同步**（与「插件」「技能」并列），四个页签：

| 备份 | 历史版本 |
| --- | --- |
| ![备份](docs/images/01-backup.png) | ![历史版本](docs/images/02-history.png) |

| 导入 | 同步 |
| --- | --- |
| ![导入](docs/images/03-import.png) | ![同步](docs/images/04-sync.png) |

- **备份**：勾模块 → 填输出目录 → 打一个包（可选打包前跑校验）。
  卡片展开后给的是**人话清单**，不是文件路径：技能卡一行一个技能，插件卡一行一个插件
  （显示名 / 真正装上的版本 / `已启用 · 仅依赖 · 未安装 · 内置 · 本地目录` 徽标，悬停看说明、
  单击开详情、双击复制包名），文件明细退成旁边一条「查看 N 个文件」。
- **历史版本**：列出输出目录里的包（时间、体积、来源机器、模块数、文件数），
  可就地**校验**（比对 sha256）、**导入**、**复制路径**。
- **导入**：选一个包 → 扫描 → 逐文件差异预览（新增 / 修改 / 删除 / 冲突）→ 逐项裁决 → 应用。
  应用前自动把当前状态快照到 `<输出目录>/pre-restore-<时间戳>/`。
  「备份包」下拉分**本机**与**云端（WebDAV）**两组，云端每项标着「本机已有 / 本机没有」；
  挑云端那份点「分析差异」时**本机没有的会自动下载**（本机已有就跳过，不白下几百 MB）。
- **同步**：把包推到「同步目录」（OneDrive / 坚果云 / 群晖 / U 盘都行），带 sha256 校验。
  下面还有一张**云端（WebDAV）**卡片：填地址 / 账号 / 口令 / 远端目录 →「保存并测试连接」→
  上传 / 列出远端 / 下载到本机 / 删远端（详见[云端备份](#云端备份webdav)）。

## 六个模块

| 模块 | 界面名 | 根目录 | 收录内容 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `skills` | 技能 | `<userHome>/.agents/skills` | 整棵技能树（按技能目录计数） | ✅ |
| `plugins` | 插件 | `<dshHome>/profiles/<profile>/` | `package.json`、`pnpm-lock.yaml`、`.npmrc`、`pnpm-workspace.yaml`（界面上另按清单列出**装了哪些插件**） | ✅ |
| `config` | 配置 | `<dshHome>/profiles/<profile>/` 与 `<dshHome>/` | `cordis.patch.yml`、`settings.yaml`、`AGENTS.md` | ✅ |
| `memory` | 记忆 | `<dshHome>/memories/` | `MEMORY.md` / `USER.md` / `KEY.md` / `daily/*.md` 等（**不含**待办文件） | ✅ |
| `todo` | 待办 | `<dshHome>/memories/` | `TODOS-life.md`、`TODOS-work.md`、`projects/<hash>/TODOS.md`、`daily/YYYY-MM-DD.todo.md` | ✅ |
| `sessions` | 对话 | `<dshHome>/sessions/` | 全部会话记录 | ⬜ **本地专用 · 不上云** |

两个设计细节：

1. **模块按「文件模式」切分，不按目录切分**。记忆与待办同居 `memories/` 一棵树：
   `projects/<hash>/MEMORY.md` 是记忆，隔壁的 `projects/<hash>/TODOS.md` 是待办。
   按目录切必然切错，所以用文件模式互斥认领（有测试钉住「每个路径恰好属于一个模块」）。
2. **对话默认不勾选**，并在界面上标注「本地专用 · 不上云」——它体积大、含隐私，
   而且通常没必要跟着人走。

## 文件放在哪

插件自己的状态（都在本机，不进包）：

```
<dshHome>/backup-sync/settings.json   # 你的设置（输出目录、同步目录、定时…）
<dshHome>/backup-sync/state.json      # 基线库：上次打包时各文件的 sha256
```

备份包（默认输出目录，可用设置覆盖）：

```
dsh-sync-20261014-093012.tar.gz        # 归档本体
dsh-sync-20261014-093012.tar.gz.sha256 # 边车校验文件
```

包内结构（归档内是**归一化布局**，与机器无关）：

```
dsh/      ← 对应 <dshHome> 下的文件（profiles/… memories/… sessions/…）
agents/   ← 对应 <userHome>/.agents 下的文件（skills/…）
manifest.json   ← 格式版本、时间、来源机器、模块清单、逐文件 sha256
```

默认输出目录的选取规则：Windows 上确实存在 `D:` 盘、且 `<dshHome>` 位于
`<userHome>` 之下（判定为「真实安装」）时用 `D:\dsh-backups-sync`；
否则落在 `<userHome>/dsh-backups-sync`。
**绝不默认写到一个这台机器上不存在的路径。**

## 增量导入：基线三方合并

导入不是「解压覆盖」，而是三方合并：

```
base   = 基线库（上次打包时，两边都认可的共同祖先）
ours   = 这台机器现在的状态
theirs = 包里的状态
```

逐文件判定：

| 情况 | 动作 |
| --- | --- |
| 只有 `theirs` 变了 | 采纳包里的版本 |
| 只有 `ours` 变了 | **保留本地**，静默跳过 |
| 两边都变了且内容不同 | **冲突** → 弹差异预览，逐个选 |
| 本地删了、包里改了 | 冲突（默认保留本地） |
| 包里删了、本地没动 | 删除（需显式开启 `allowDelete`，默认关闭） |

几个刻意的选择：

- **冲突默认「保留本地」**。裁决完之后，基线记的是**归档版本**而不是本地版本 ——
  否则下次导入会把用户刚裁决保留的版本判成「归档改了、本地没动」而擅自覆盖，裁决等于白做。
- **合并粒度按内容类型定**：技能 = 整个目录；配置文件 = 整个文件（默认保留本地）；
  插件清单 = JSON 字段级；记忆 = 按内容行去重；待办 = 按 8 位十六进制 id；会话 = 整个文件。
- **删除是关着的**。`allowDelete` 默认 `false`，想同步「删除」这个动作必须手动开。
- **导入前自动快照**：`<输出目录>/pre-restore-<时间戳>/` 就是一份能原样还原的包。

## 两条红线

1. **凭据永不进包、永不进基线。** `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 之类的凭据文件在扫描阶段
   就被排除（27 个凭据文件名 + 7 个后缀的黑名单，另有 1 MiB 内容闸）。
   **导入侧还会再拦一次**：老版本打的包、别人给的包里若带着这类文件，只会显示为
   「跳过」，不会写进本机。包里不可能出现 API key。
2. **对话默认不参与。** 想备份对话要手动勾 —— 它只在本机流转，不会被同步。

## 定时备份

在设置里打开后，插件在宿主进程里定时打包。两种频率：**每天某个时刻**（默认 `03:00`）
或**每隔 N 小时**（1–720，默认 24）。约定：

- **DSH 没开就不补跑**（不做启动补跑，也不装系统计划任务）；
- **失败不重试**，下一次到点照常；
- 只清理**自己打的包**，且 `keep <= 0` 表示不清理；
- 「立即跑一次」按钮绕过开关，用于验证；
- 定时范围默认跟随「备份」页当前勾选的模块，可 pin 成固定集合；
- **对话永远不会进定时包。**

## 云端备份（WebDAV）

「同步」页签里有一张**云端（WebDAV）**卡片。填四个字段就能用：

| 字段 | 例子 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 云端地址 | `http://192.168.3.1:5005/` | NAS 上 WebDAV 服务给出的地址（**要带协议**，端口按 NAS 说明填） |
| 账号 / 口令 | `dsh` / `******` | 口令建议用 NAS 里给应用生成的**专用密码**，不要用登录密码 |
| 远端目录 | `dsh-backup` | 云端根目录下的一个子目录，**第一次上传会自动创建** |
| 传完自动上传 | 开关 | 打开后每次「立即跑一次」或定时打包成功，自动把最新的包传上去 |

点「保存并测试连接」会当场告诉你通不通（口令错会明确显示 `401`）；界面上还有
**传最新一份上去 / 列出远端 / 下载到本机 / 删远端** 四个动作。

换机流程：新机器装好插件 → 填**同一个** WebDAV 地址与目录 → 到「导入」页签展开「备份包」下拉，
云端那一组里直接挑（每项都标着「本机已有 / 本机没有」）→ 点「分析差异」，
**本机没有的会先自动下载**（带 `.sha256` 的核对哈希）→ 预览 → 应用。

也可以走同步页签：「列出远端」→「下载到本机」→ 再回「导入」页签选它 —— 两条路等价。

![导入页签的「备份包」下拉里直接挑云端的包](docs/images/05-cloud-import.png)

上图是真机截的：下拉里选中的就是云端那份（`云端 · 2026-10-17 10:39:51 · 本机已有`），
下面一行说明云端一共几份、点「分析差异」会发生什么。

安全约定（这几条是硬编码的，不是提示）：

- 口令**单独**存在 `<dshHome>/backup-sync/cloud-credentials.json`（权限 `0600`），
  不进设置文件、不进日志、界面里读不回来（只显示「已保存」）。
- 这个凭据文件名在黑名单里 —— **既不会被打进备份包，也不会被导入**。
- 远端只认**自己打的包**：名字必须匹配 `dsh-sync-<时间戳>.tar.gz`。别的名字（包括

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Desktop: dropped files and folders become @path references instead of uploads, by wiring the shell file-path bridge into the composer host-path seam.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-host-paths

**把文件拖进 DSH Desktop，输入框里得到的是 `@路径` 引用，而不是一份被上传的副本。**

[dsh-host-paths](https://github.com/384124694/dsh-host-paths) 是一个只做一件事的小插件：把桌面壳 preload 里的文件路径桥
（`window.__DSH_DESKTOP_FILE_PATH__`）接到 DSH 输入框**本来就有**的宿主路径接缝
（`globalThis.__DSH_HOST_PATHS__`）上。接上之后，官方 composer 自己就会把拖入的文件转成
`@路径` chip——不需要插件抢事件，也不需要它替你读文件。

## 问题

DSH 的输入框里有两条互斥的落地路径（`dsh-client-ui-conversation` 的 `addFiles`）：

```
path = 宿主路径桥?.pathFor(file) ?? ""
path === "" || 图片        → 上传（file draft，物化到会话附件目录）
否则                      → @路径 引用 chip（零上传）
```

而 `__DSH_HOST_PATHS__` 这个名字在 DSH Desktop 里**没有任何代码写入**：壳只暴露
`__DSH_DESKTOP_FILE_PATH__`（Electron `webUtils.getPathForFile`）。于是第二条分支永远不走，
拖什么都是上传——哪怕 Electron 明明知道那个文件的真实路径。

本插件就是把这两个名字接起来的那一行。

## 装上之后

| 你做的事 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 拖入非图片文件（docx / xlsx / pdf / zip…） | 输入框出现 `@绝对路径` chip，**零上传、零复制**；文件在工作区内时自动写成相对路径 |
| 拖入文件夹 | 出现 `@路径/` 文件夹 chip |
| 拖入图片 | 仍走原生图片通道上传（官方设计：缩略图、尺寸探测、多图限额都在这条路上） |
| 路径含空格 | 自动用 `@"带 空格 的 路径.docx"` 引号语法 |
| 壳拿不到真路径（OneDrive 占位符、压缩包内拖出、纯浏览器打开） | 自动回落成官方原有的上传行为，不会报错 |

**不做**的事：不读文件内容、不复制、不搬移、不删改、不联网、不注册任何 host 服务，
也不覆盖别人已经装好的同名前接缝（未来的 DSH 如果自己接了，本插件自动让位）。

## 安装

```sh
# 从 GitHub（建议钉住 commit）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:384124694/dsh-host-paths#<sha>

# 从本地检出
git clone https://github.com/384124694/dsh-host-paths.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:$HOME/dsh-host-paths
```

`--profile` 填你实际在用的那个（DSH Desktop 通常是 `desktop`，纯 `dsh web` 是 `web`）。
**重启 DSH Desktop（或重跑 `dsh web`）并刷新页面**后生效——客户端半是启动时编进
`__DSH_BOOT__` 的。包内已带构建产物（`lib/`），无需构建步骤。

## 验证

F12 打开 Console：

```js
window.__DSH_HOST_PATHS__                        // 装好后应为 { pathFor: ƒ }
typeof window.__DSH_DESKTOP_FILE_PATH__?.getPathForFile   // 应为 "function"
window.__DSH_HOST_PATHS__.pathFor($0)            // 在 Elements 里选中一个 file input 的 File 再试
```

然后拖一个非图片文件：输入框应出现 `@路径` chip，**输入框上方不该出现文件卡片**（那就是上传）。

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-host-paths
```

重启后接缝消失，拖拽回到官方默认行为。

## 开发

```sh
npm test        # node --test：7 项行为测试，不需要 DSH 服务器
```

`lib/client.js` 是手写的经典脚本（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`），
没有构建步骤：改完直接重启 profile 即可。`lib/index.js` 是空的 host 半，只为了让这个 bundle
在 Loader 里有一个条目、客户端产物才会进 `__DSH_BOOT__`。

## 已知边界

- **只在 DSH Desktop（Electron）里有意义。** 普通浏览器没有路径桥，本插件静默不装接缝，
  拖拽保持官方行为（上传）——它不会假装成功。
- **图片仍然上传**，这是官方 composer 的既定分支，本插件不改变它。
- 引用 chip 里的路径：文件在工作区内时是相对 cwd 的路径，否则是绝对路径。
- 若某个未来 DSH 版本自己写了 `__DSH_HOST_PATHS__`，本插件检测到已有值就不覆盖。

## License

MIT

# dsh-test-framework > 面向**测试工程师**的 DSH 插件：把一个空文件夹变成你自己的「测试工作框架」，并在 AI 会话里 > **自动带上框架约束**、把「需求文档 → 子模块拆分 → 版本 / 跨文档关联 / 测试环境账密」这条链 > 做成**绕不过去的闸门**。 > > - 宿主是 **cordis 插件**，**零第三方依赖**（只用 Node 内置模块），**无前端构建步骤** > - 插件版本：`0.2.9` ｜ 适配：DSH（`dsh.engines.dsh = "*"`）｜ Node ≥ 20 --- ## 〇、前置条件（**装之前先确认**） | 外部 MCP | 必需？ | 没有会怎样 | | --- | --- | --- | | **playwright MCP**（`mcp__playwright__browser_*`） | ✅ **必需，且没有替代路径** | 「看着页面操作流程」这类验证**做不了**。框架铁律 10 要求「必须真实浏览器 + 真实点击/输入」，**明确不许**用只读 DOM / 只抓报文 / 离线脚本 / 旧截图冒充 —— 所以缺它**不是"降级运行"，而是"这条要求根本执行不了"**。
插件会在**会话开头的「测试框架状态」段落**和 **`test_framework_status` 输出**里报「**未检测到 playwright MCP（必需）**」；看到就先配好再开工 | | `keyword_mcp`（接口报文落盘 / toast 历史） | 建议 | 少一条**取证**通道（与 playwright **互补不替代**） | | `cr69_mcp`（Chromium 69） | 可选 | 老内核 / 小视口**兼容性**验证做不了 | **配在哪**：DSH profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` —— 加一个 `mcp-playwright` 服务（`serverName: playwright`， 命令用 `@playwright/mcp`），并且**必须有头（窗口可见）**，否则"看着"是假的。 ⚠️ **改完必须重启 DSH**（profile 层不热加载）。 **自查**： ```powershell # npm 安装的用户 npx dsh-test-framework doctor # 在测试框架里（插件源码在 _plugin\ 下） node _plugin\dsh-test-framework\lib\cli.js doctor ``` `doctor` 会把这三项逐个列出来（"已检测到" / "**未检测到**" / "无法判定"）。 ⚠️ 口径说明：插件是靠读 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 来判断的，**"未检测到"≠"一定不存在"** （你也可能用别的方式起这个 MCP）—— 真查不到时它会说"**无法判定**"，不会硬下结论。 --- ## 一、它解决什么问题 用 DSH 做需求测试时，反复出问题的是这几件事 —— 它们**不是能力问题，是纪律问题**： | 痛点 | 本插件的处置 | | --- | --- | | 新建一个文件夹就要**手工搭一遍框架骨架**（AGENTS.md / skills / _templates / 产品级规范 / 目录联接） | `test_framework_init` 一条命令生成，**已存在即跳过、不覆盖** | | 在 `<产品>\<模块>\` 这种**子目录**里开会话，框架根 `AGENTS.md` **静默不加载**（DSH 只认 `.git` 当项目根） | 初始化时建 `.git` 标记；并且插件**另注入一段实时状态**，没加载成也会明说 | | 120 页的需求文档含 3 个子模块，AI **自己就拆了**或干脆不拆 | 探针给页数/章节/菜单命中 → 命中判据就**必须**用 `ask_user_question` 让用户确认，不许自作主张 | | 某个业务逻辑其实写在**另一份需求文档**里，没人问过 | 闸门 `crossDocChecked`：**必须问过**（答"没有"要落 `relatedDocs: []`，缺 key = 没问过） | | 需求文档路径不区分版本，测错版本全白干 | 闸门 `versionsConfirmed`，并在流程里写死"不许用文件时间判版本" | | 每次都要重新问一遍环境地址、账号密码、数据库地址 | `test_framework_record` 落**产品级规范**（人读的 md + 机器读的 json），下次直接命中 | | 密码散落到脚本和报告里 | 明文**只落 `_框架配置\环境与账密.md`**，`框架登记.json` 里只记指针（有测试守着） | | 报告越堆越多，模块 `report\` 里几个月前的报告还混在最新一批里 | `test_framework_report_gc`：满 24h 的报告移进 `_archive\报告归档\<模块>\<日期>\`（**归档不是删除**，台账记着原名与日期）；agent 入口**默认只预演** | | 报告写成"密密麻麻一大长篇"，看不出有几条、最严重的是哪条、差在需求哪一句 | `AGENTS.md` 铁律 4 + 测试报告模板**硬性要求**：结论先行 + 缺陷速览表在最前 + 一条缺陷一小节（≤20 行）+ 复现步骤可照做 + **每条写「需求原文依据」与「与需求不符点」** | | 一个模块测了好几版，几版的口径/造数逻辑/坑**全揉在一份 `SKILL.md` 里**，用的时候不知道哪句对哪版 | 模块 `SKILL.md` 降为**索引**，每版一份 `skill\<版本>\SKILL.md`，**一版一份、多版并存、互不覆盖**；`test_framework_module_add` 传 `version` 就自动建好并回填索引 §8 版本索引 | | **别的项目 / 别的工具的规矩渗进本框架** —— 它的"落盘必须在自己的工作区内"变成了本框架的规矩，于是模块里被建出一批**永远装不进东西的** `temps\` 空壳、模块 `SKILL.md` 里留下"照着做必然失败"的经验 | `lib\isolation.js`：① 会话开头先说清**当前会话的项目根是谁、会加载哪份 `AGENTS.md`**（嵌套仓库截断 / 找不到 `.git` 退回 cwd / 项目根跑到框架外，三种都认）；② 模块里出现**外部工具的工作目录**就报，并写明正确做法（落它自己的工作区 → 证据拷回模块 `data\`）；③ `doctor` 一并列出周边**所有**外部权威来源（别处的 `AGENTS.md`、`.trae` 规范库） | --- ## 二、装插件 ### 路线 A：从 npm 装（别人用这条） ```powershell # DSH 插件就是 npm 包 —— `dsh plugin ...` 本身就是转发给 pnpm dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-test-framework # 重启 DSH（profile 的 bundles 层与 cordis.patch.yml **不支持热加载**，不重启不生效） ``` 装完看会话里有没有 `test_framework_status` 工具，或跑： ```powershell npx dsh-test-framework doctor --profile desktop ``` ### 路线 B：从源码装（改代码时用这条） ```powershell cd <插件目录> # ① 看计划（不写盘） node lib\cli.js install --profile desktop # ② 真装（链接安装：`link:` + 目录联接，不跑 pnpm） node lib\cli.js install --profile desktop --apply # ③ 重启 DSH ``` 自检： ```powershell node lib\cli.js doctor --profile desktop ``` `doctor` 会逐项报：插件清单 / 入口 / `cordis.patch.yml` / Node 版本 / 找不找得到 `dsh` 与 `pnpm` / 这个 profile 里**依赖与 bundles 两处是不是都有**（只有一处 = 半装 = 不会加载）。 ### 可选配置 ```yaml # profile 的 cordis.patch.yml —— 把需求文档总根目录固定下来 - id: test-framework config: reqDocRoot: '<你的需求文档总根目录>' ``` 不配也可以：省略时按「插件配置 → 环境变量 `DSH_REQ_DOC_ROOT` → `<用户主目录>\需求业务文档`」解析。 **插件里没有写死任何绝对路径**（有测试守着这一条）。 ### 默认为什么**不**跑 `dsh plugin add` 默认走的是「**链接安装**」：备份 `package.json` → 给 `dependencies` 和 `dsh.profile.bundles` 各加一条 → 在 `node_modules` 里建一个**目录联接**。`link:` 依赖的本质就是这个联接， 所以这条路和 pnpm 的产出等价，但**不碰整棵 `node_modules`**。 `dsh plugin add` 会在 profile 目录里**真跑一次 `pnpm install`**。实测本机 desktop profile 的 `node_modules\@deepseek-ai` 处于**两个 dsh 版本混链**的状态（`profiles\node_modules` 下 `0.1.1-rc.2` 与 `0.1.5-rc.3` 混着指），一次 `pnpm install` 很可能把这棵树"规范化"掉、 **连带影响正在运行的 DSH**。装一个小插件不值得冒这个险。 要用官方命令（或补跑 pnpm）： ```powershell # 官方命令：会真跑 pnpm install node ...\cli.js install --profile desktop --apply --official # 链接安装 + 之后再补跑一次 pnpm install node ...\cli.js install --profile desktop --apply --pnpm ``` ### 关于本机有多个 `dsh` 本机 npx 缓存里有 **4 个** dsh（`0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.1.7-rc.1` / `0.1.5-rc.3` / `0.1.1-rc.2`）， 而 profile 的 `node_modules` 是混链的。所以 `doctor` / `install` 挑 dsh 的顺序是 **PATH → 这个 profile 自己链的那个 → npm 全局 → npx 缓存（版本降序）**，并把候选全列出来； 要指定就 `--dsh `。 （找 profile 自己链的那个时**要查两层**：`\node_modules` 与 `\profiles\node_modules` —— 本机 `@deepseek-ai\dsh` 挂在**上一层**，只查自己那层会挑错版本。） **怎么确认真装上了**：重启后新开一个会话，看 skill 列表里有没有 `test-framework-onboard`、 工具列表里有没有 `test_framework_status`；或直接说一句"看下测试框架状态"。 （本次装到 `desktop` profile 后**无需重启就已生效**：会话的 skill 目录里已出现 4 个 `test-framework*` skill，`dsh --profile desktop --dump-config` 里能看到 `- id: test-framework`。） ### 卸载 ```powershell node lib\cli.js uninstall --profile desktop ``` 只摘掉 profile 的依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 条目（改前**一定先备份**成 `package.json.bak-testfw-<日期>`）， 并摘掉手动建的那个目录联接（不然会留下一个指向已卸载插件的死链接）。 **不动框架工作区里的任何文件** —— 卸载插件 ≠ 删框架。 --- ## 三、装完能得到什么 ### 3.1 七个工具 | 工具 | 干什么 | | --- | --- | | `test_framework_status` | **开工前先调它**。返回框架根、产品与模块、登记到哪一步、**还缺哪些项**。`ready: false` 时不许直接开测 | | `test_framework_init` | 把（空的）文件夹初始化成框架骨架。`dryRun: true` 只看计划 | | `test_framework_module_add` | 新增一个模块（= 系统里的一个**叶子菜单**；父菜单不建目录、只作菜单路径）：建 `requirement/final/report/data/skill` + 渲染**模块索引** `SKILL.md` + 传 `version` 时再建 `skill\<版本>\SKILL.md`（**一版一份，互不覆盖**）并回填索引 §8 版本索引，最后**同时**回填框架根 `AGENTS.md` §三 与产品级 `模块路由.md` | | `test_framework_link` | **跨端关联的只读体检**（**不改任何文件**）：查 关联边两端模块是否存在 / **单向边**（只有 A→B 没有 B→A）/ **链路断点** / **端前缀命名**（默认端不带前缀、非默认端必须带 `<端>-`）/ 非默认端没写逻辑业务对象 / 路由漂移 / 模块登记落点缺失。返回结论行 + 错误清单 + 摘要（模块数 / 关联边数 / 链路数 / 各端模块数）；命令行等价入口 `node lib\cli.js link` |（版本/页数/拆分/关联文档/取消项核对）与**测试环境与账密**，落产品级规范 | | `test_framework_doc_probe` | **零依赖**探一份 docx：页数（优先 Word 自己记的 `Pages`）、章节树、表格、图片数、**带删除线的段落数**、疑似子模块、命中的顶级菜单，以及**拆分判定** | | `test_framework_report_gc` | **报告回收**：把满 N 小时（默认 24）的报告从模块 `report\` 移进 `_archive\报告归档\<模块>\<日期>\`。**默认 `dryRun: true` 只预演**，确认后传 `dryRun: false` 才真搬。它**不重写归档逻辑** —— 只是去找并调用框架里那份 `archive_reports.py`，所以不存在"两套规则打架" | ### 3.2 四个 runtime skill（自动加载） | skill | 什么时候命中 | | --- | --- | | `test-framework` | 测试框架总契约：三层结构、目录约定、12 条铁律摘要、闸门表 | | `test-framework-init` | 「初始化测试框架」「把空文件夹变成测试框架」 | | **`test-framework-onboard`** | **「测这份需求文档」「新版需求」「要不要拆」「测试环境地址/账号密码」** —— 这就是那条强制引导流程 | | `test-framework-module` | 「新增模块」「这个功能算哪个模块」 | > ⚠️ runtime skill 的 rank 是 **250**；**项目级** skill（`<框架根>\skills\<同名>\SKILL.md`，rank 100）会覆盖它。 > 也就是说：你在自己框架里写的同名 skill 永远优先，插件不跟你抢。 ### 3.3 一段系统提示词 + 两个斜杠命令 - **系统提示词段落**：每次组装提示词时求值，把「框架根有没有 `.git`」「哪个产品还缺哪几项登记」 实时摆到模型面前。**空的时候返回空字符串**，不占上下文。 > 这是"闸门拦得住人"的关键：产品级/模块级规范**不会被自动加载**，光靠 `AGENTS.md` 拦不住。 - **同一段里还会摆出"契约边界"**（`lib\isolation.js`）：当前会话的项目根是谁、**会加载哪份 `AGENTS.md`**、 模块里有没有被塞进**外部工具的工作目录**。**只报要拦的**（嵌套仓库把项目根截断 / 向上没 `.git` 退回 cwd / 项目根跑到框架外 / 模块里出现 `temps\` 这类目录），**一切正常就一个字都不说**。 起因是**真事故**：别的项目的规矩渗进来，模块里被建出一批**永远装不进东西**的空壳。 完整画面（含"周边有哪些外部权威来源"）在 `test_framework_status` 与 `doctor` 里。 - `/tf-status`、`/tf-gate`：等价于查状态，**不消耗模型回轮**（结果不进模型历史）。 --- ## 四、引导流程长什么样（`test-framework-onboard`） 需求文档动辄 100+ 页，模型不可能整篇读进来。流程刻意设计成「先出结论 → 人确认 → 再动手」： ``` ① test_framework_status 先认账，看缺什么 定位需求文档（不许猜路径） ② test_framework_doc_probe 页数 / 章节 / 菜单命中 / 删除线段落 → 拆分判定（命中任一判据就停下来问） A 页数 > 100 B 一/二级标题里有 ≥2 个独立业务功能名 C 正文里有 ≥2 个不同的顶级菜单名 ← 最硬的判据，基本不误报 D 用户口述里有并列词（"包含/以及/里面还有"） → ask_user_question 摆出「建议拆分方案 + 依据（章节号/页数区间）」等用户确认 ③ 跨文档关联：问"本地还有哪些需求文档跟它有关联"（答没有要落 []） ④ 版本确认：问"本次测的是哪一版"（不许用文件时间判版本） ⑤ 环境与账密：页面地址 + 账号密码 + 数据库地址/账号密码 + 数据地址 ⑥ test_framework_module_add × N（每个子模块一次） ⑦ test_framework_record（文档 + 环境） ⑧ test_framework_status 返回 ready: true 才允许开测 ``` **范例**（用户自己举的例子）：需求文档写的是「**药品联动保障**」，

plugins.description: Trae CN as a native DeepSeek Harness LLM provider: browser OAuth login by default, an opt-in local-install credential source, and an OpenAI-compatible surface on the host web server.
plugins.readme_text:
# trae-cn-provider 把 **Trae CN** 作为一个**原生 LLM provider** 接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）。 安装后 Trae 的模型会直接出现在 DSH 的模型选择器里，也可以额外开出一个 OpenAI 兼容接口给 Cline / Claude Code 之类的客户端用。 macOS 优先、源码可审计、**凭据不出本机**。 --- ## ⚠️ 先读这一段：风险声明 1. **本项目违反 Trae（字节跳动）的使用条款。** 它把 Trae 客户端内部的接口当作通用 LLM API 使用，这不是官方支持的用法。 2. **你的 Trae 账号有被封禁的风险。** 请自行判断是否接受。 3. 消耗的是**你自己账号的额度/积分**。本项目不提供、不转让、不代充任何额度。 4. 本项目与 Trae、字节跳动**没有任何关系**，未获其授权或背书。 5. 请**不要**把本插件连同你的凭据一起分发。凭据只应存在于你自己的机器上。 6. 作者不对因使用本项目产生的任何后果负责（包括但不限于账号封禁、额度损失、数据问题）。**如果你不接受以上任何一条，请不要安装。** --- ## 它做什么 - 以 DSH **原生 `LlmAdapter`** 的形式注册一个 provider route：`trae-cn` - 模型自动出现在模型选择器（从 Trae 的模型目录实时拉取） - 支持流式正文、思考链（reasoning）、原生 function calling、上下文窗口、思考档位 - 支持**图片输入**（多模态模型）：DSH 的图片块经 attachments 缝内联为 data URL；OpenAI 层也接受 `image_url` - 可选：在宿主已有的 web server 上挂一个 OpenAI 兼容面（`/v1/models`、`/v1/chat/completions`），**不自己占用端口** - 同时提供一个独立 CLI，可脱离 DSH 单独当本地代理跑 ## 它不做什么 - 不代理、不中转、不上传任何凭据到第三方。**代码里出网的域名只有 Trae 官方域名**（见「出网清单」）。 - 不共享额度给别人，不做多账号池，不做额度转卖。 - 不修改 Trae 客户端，不 hook 它的进程。 --- ## 安装 ```bash # 从 npm 安装到 web profile（安装即激活：会自动追加进 dsh.profile.bundles） dsh plugin --profile web add trae-cn-provider # 桌面版：需要先完全退出 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用 dsh plugin --profile desktop add trae-cn-provider ``` > **桌面 profile 的坑**：`dsh plugin --profile desktop` 要求桌面应用完全退出后再执行 > （否则报 `Open DeepSeek Harness Desktop once to initialize its profile, then fully quit it`）。 > 卸载：`dsh plugin --profile

remove trae-cn-provider`。 安装后重启对应 profile 即可。模型选择器里会出现 **Trae CN** 分组。 --- ## 登录与凭据来源 插件有三档凭据来源，通过 `credentialSource` 配置： | 值 | 行为 | 需要浏览器 | 包内是否存在解密凭据的代码路径 | |---|---|---|---| | `oauth`（**默认**） | 只在 DSH 里走一次浏览器登录，凭据存本机 | 是（一次） | **否** | | `local` | 直接读本机已登录的 Trae 客户端凭据 | 否 | **是（显式开启才生效）** | | `auto` | 先看已保存的 OAuth 凭据，没有再看本机客户端 | 视情况 | 是（同上） | ### `oauth`（默认，推荐） 在 DSH 里执行登录命令（默认 `/trae-login`），会打开浏览器到 Trae 官方授权页： ``` https://www.trae.cn/authorization?...&auth_callback_url=http://127.0.0.1:/authorize ``` **实测发现：Trae 的回调不是下发授权码，而是直接把凭据塞进回调参数**（`userJwt` 是 URL 编码的 JSON，含 `Token` / `RefreshToken` / `TokenExpireAt`；`userInfo` 含 `UserID` / `Name`）。所以不存在「换码」这一步。回调只在 `127.0.0.1` 上临时监听，拿完即关。 凭据默认落在 `~/.trae-proxy/credentials.json`（权限 `0600`）。若 DSH 的 `credentials` 服务可用，会优先存进那里。 目录可以用环境变量 `TRAE_PROXY_CRED_DIR` 覆盖（测试用它做隔离；也可以在你想把凭据放到别处时用）。 ### `local`（可选，零摩擦） 直接读本机 Trae 客户端的登录态，**不需要浏览器**。支持两种存储格式，运行时自动嗅探： | edition | 存储格式 | 上游 | |---|---|---| | `cn` Trae CN | `tc` 加密 | `trae-api-cn.mchost.guru` | | `solo` TRAE SOLO CN | `tc` 加密 | `trae-api-cn.mchost.guru` | | `sg` Trae 国际版 | 明文 JSON | `a0ai-api-sg.byteintlapi.com` | | `solo-sg` TRAE SOLO | `tc` 加密 | `a0ai-api-sg.byteintlapi.com` | 路径：macOS `~/Library/Application Support//User/globalStorage/storage.json`，Windows `%APPDATA%\\User\globalStorage\storage.json`。 > **必须知道的取舍**：`tc`
